design system · creator studio · 2026-06-01

Creator-economy operations dashboard.創作者經濟營運儀表板

The back-office where independent creators turn IP, projects, and fans into income — transparently. Clean white canvas with neutral light-gray surfaces, highlighter-orange primary, Satoshi typography (Geist fallback), flat 1px borders on default cards and controls (Q3/Q4 2026-07-13), multi-layer rim+drop shadows reserved for popovers/overlays and clickable-card hover.

讓獨立創作者把 IP、項目與粉絲透明地轉化為收入的後台。純白畫布配中性淺灰表面、highlighter 橘為主色、Satoshi 字體（Geist 備援），預設卡片與控件用扁平 1px 邊框（Q3/Q4 2026-07-13），多層 rim+drop 陰影只保留給浮層／對話框與可點卡片的 hover。

Category — Creator-economy operations dashboard: IP licensing, projects, events, products, fans (CRM), and earnings, with finance / royalties / verification states kept legible. Theme: light / dark / system.

類別 — 創作者經濟營運儀表板：IP 授權、項目、活動、商品、粉絲（CRM）與收益，並讓 finance / royalties / verification 狀態保持清楚易讀。主題：light / dark / system。

Locales — en (primary) · zh-Hant (secondary), toggled in the topbar and persisted. CJK glyphs are split across two self-hosted subset typefaces — LINE Seed TW for headings (--font-cjk-display) and Chiron Hei HK (昭源黑體) for body/UI (--font-cjk) — with Noto Sans TC appended as the final fallback in both stacks (2026-07-28 裁示).

語系 — en (primary) · zh-Hant (secondary)，在 topbar 切換並保存設定。中文字由兩支自架 subset 字型分工——標題用 LINE Seed TW（--font-cjk-display），內文／UI 用「昭源黑體」Chiron Hei HK（--font-cjk）——兩個 stack 末端都接 Noto Sans TC 當最終備援（2026-07-28 裁示）。

Tags — creator-economy operations-dashboard satoshi-stack clean-white-canvas subtle-radii multi-layer-shadows dashboard-hero row-divider-data light-and-dark highlighter-orange-primary

Discipline

Top-level Do / Don't.最高原則 該做 / 別做

Do該做

  • Reserve #ffa33f for one structural accent per viewport (CTA, active tabs, selection-card selected state, or hero — not several at once; info banners stay neutral gray, nav active states stay neutral gray, Q8).
  • 每個視窗只保留 #ffa33f 給一個結構性重點（CTA、active tabs、selection-card 已選態或 hero，不要同時用好幾個；info banner 與 nav active 一律中性灰，Q8）。
  • Pair --primary with --primary-foreground (#171717) text — never white-on-orange.
  • --primary 一律搭配 --primary-foreground（#171717）文字，絕不用白字配橘底。
  • Define edges with a real 1px --border on default cards and form controls (Q3/Q4 2026-07-13); reserve multi-layer shadows (--shadow-card = rim + drop) for popovers/overlays and clickable-card hover.
  • 預設卡片與表單控件的邊緣一律用真正的 1px --border（Q3/Q4 2026-07-13）；多層陰影（--shadow-card = rim + drop）只保留給浮層／對話框與可點卡片的 hover。
  • Spell out money state inline: "Available $842 · Pending $1,204".
  • 把金額狀態直接寫出來：「Available $842 · Pending $1,204」。

Don't別做

  • Don't use solid orange for nav active fills or status pills — since Q8-A (2026-07-27) nav active is an orange tint (--selected-surface + --selected-ink); hover is still --accent (Q9) and status pills keep their status tokens. --sidebar-active is now a fallback only and is unused (待採用).
  • 別把實色橘用在 nav active 的填色或 status pill——Q8-A（2026-07-27）之後導覽已選是橘色 tint（--selected-surface ＋ --selected-ink）；hover 仍是 --accent（Q9），status pill 用各自的狀態 token。--sidebar-active 已退為回退值、目前無人引用（待採用）。
  • Don't fall back to a shadow-simulated hairline on cards / inputs where the shipped CSS uses a real 1px solid --border (Q3/Q4) — shadow-as-edge is now for popovers / overlays / clickable-card hover only.
  • 別在已改用真 1px solid --border 的 cards / inputs 上退回陰影模擬細邊（Q3/Q4）——陰影當邊框現在只留給浮層／對話框與可點卡片的 hover。
  • Don't show a bare number without its currency + state.
  • 別只顯示沒有幣別與狀態的裸數字。
  • Don't use Title Case on buttons — sentence case ("Create project").
  • 按鈕別用 Title Case，用 sentence case（「Create project」）。
  • Don't put more than one Primary button in a row.
  • 同一列別放超過一個 Primary 按鈕。
Discipline

Style decisions landed (2026-07-13, Q1–Q12).風格裁決落地（2026-07-13，Q1–Q12）

Twelve style calls resolved on 2026-07-13; CSS already ships this — this table is the rule summary for new components going forward.

2026-07-13 落地的 12 條風格裁決；CSS 已經改完，這張表是給後續新元件對齊用的規則摘要。

Q1Shape = interactivity cue — clickable pill (chip, filter-tabs) = full-round --radius-pill; display-only badge (badge, field-pill, metric-pill) = small rounded rect --radius.形狀＝可否互動的線索——可點膠囊（chip、filter-tabs）＝全圓 --radius-pill；純顯示徽章（badge、field-pill、metric-pill）＝小圓角矩形 --radius。
Q2Radius unified to 6px — --radius-md is now an alias of --radius. Exceptions: pill (9999px), shell (28px), --radius-lg (8px).圓角統一 6px——--radius-md 是 --radius 的別名。例外：pill（9999px）、shell（28px）、--radius-lg（8px）。
Q3Default card = 1px flat --border. Only clickable/lift cards (.ztor-card--clickable hover, .selection-card) upgrade to a flat shadow on hover.預設卡＝1px 純邊框。只有可點／浮起的強調卡（.ztor-card--clickable hover、.selection-card）hover 時才升級純陰影。
Q4Inputs use a 1px shadow edge so control sizing stays stable; focus promotes it to --ring plus a 4px soft glow.輸入控件用 1px 陰影邊線，尺寸維持穩定；focus 改為 --ring 加 4px 柔光。
Q5Hover-lift rule — clickable cards lift with --shadow-float/--shadow-card-hover; list/table rows only swap background to --accent; pure preview/display cards (preview-card, kpi) get no hover.hover 浮起規則——可點卡片 hover 借 --shadow-float/--shadow-card-hover 浮起；清單列與表格列 hover 只換底色 --accent；純預覽／展示卡（preview-card、kpi）不做 hover。
Q6Form rhythm follows base .field (label↔control 6px, field↔field 16px); .form-section no longer overrides vertical rhythm locally.表單節奏以基礎 .field 為準（描述↔控件 6px、欄位↔欄位 16px）；.form-section 不再局部覆寫垂直節奏。
Q7Card padding stays per-component (not unified): .kpi 16/18 · .card 20 · .ztor-card 24 · .selection-card 14/16 · .empty-card 32/24. New cards should match one of these, not invent a number.卡片內距對照表（維持各自密度，不硬統一）：.kpi 16/18 · .card 20 · .ztor-card 24 · .selection-card 14/16 · .empty-card 32/24。新卡片對號入座，不要隨機挑數字。
Q8Brand orange stays scoped to primary actions/categories (Tabs, selected selection-card). Nav/filter selected states stay neutral gray — .settings-nav--active and .app-sidebar already use --sidebar-active. Reversed by Q8-A on 2026-07-27: selected states now use an orange tint; --sidebar-active is unused (待採用).品牌橘只給主操作／主分類（Tabs、選擇卡已選）。導覽／篩選的已選一律中性灰——.settings-nav--active、.app-sidebar 已對齊用 --sidebar-active。
Q9Interactive hover background is always --accent (#F3F3F3 light / #2A2B2C dark — midnight-v2 2026-07-17); --muted is reserved for zebra stripes/subtle backgrounds. --secondary is retired (zero consumers, removed from _tokens.css). Exception: .filter-tabs__item:hover still uses --muted because its active state is also muted gray — hover can't outweigh selected.互動 hover 底色一律 --accent（亮 #F3F3F3／暗 #2A2B2C，2026-07-17 midnight-v2 壓暗）；--muted 只給斑馬紋／襯底。--secondary 已退役（全站零消費，已自 _tokens.css 移除）。例外：.filter-tabs__item:hover 仍用 --muted，因其 active 也是灰 muted，hover 不可比已選更重。
Q10Close icons are always the base .ztor-icon 16px — the 20px/18px overrides on .alert__close and .leave-dialog__close are removed.關閉鍵 icon 一律基礎 16px——.alert__close、.leave-dialog__close 的 20px/18px 覆寫已移除。
Q11The Paid badge (orders / order-detail) is badge--success (green) sitewide — was badge--neutral.已付款 Paid 徽章（orders／order-detail）全站一律 badge--success（綠色）——原本是 badge--neutral。
Q12Field labels use regular case (.settings-row__label) — the uppercase .gate-field__label on tier-settings.html is retired; don't add new uppercase-label one-offs.欄位標籤用一般大小寫（.settings-row__label）——tier-settings.html 原本的大寫 .gate-field__label 已退役，不再新增大寫孤例。

Raw tokens — color, type, geometry.原始 token — 色彩、字體、幾何

1.1 Color

1.1 色彩

card#FFFFFF
muted#FAFAFA

Status accents drive the status language across the app (live/paid → green, failed → red, info → blue, low-stock/warning → yellow) as data dots and status pills, never as primary UI chrome.

狀態色帶起全站的狀態語言（上線／已付款 → 綠、失敗 → 紅、資訊 → 藍、低庫存／警告 → 黃），只用在資料圓點與狀態 pill，絕不當主要 UI chrome。

Selected / active state (Q8-A, 2026-07-27)

已選中／active 狀態（Q8-A，2026-07-27）

Orange text on a near-white surface fails contrast (--primary alone is only 1.92:1) — these five tokens are the readable, WCAG-AA answer for "this is selected" and "orange used as ink, not fill". --on-primary is the separate answer for text sitting on top of solid --primary (e.g. .kpi--hero).

橘字直接鋪在近白底上對比不過關（--primary 單獨只有 1.92:1）——這五支 token 是「已選中」與「橘色當文字用」的可讀答案。--on-primary 則是另一個問題的答案：文字鋪在實色 --primary 底上時用（例如 .kpi--hero）。

brand-ink#8F4E00
on-primary#171717
selected-surface14% --primary
selected-surface-hover20% --primary
selected-ink= --brand-ink

--brand-ink light #8F4E00 / dark #ffa33f — the readable version of brand orange for text/icons on a non-orange surface (contrast ≥5.7:1 on card/sidebar/tint). --selected-ink is a semantic alias of it. --on-primary is aligned to #171717 in both themes (9.02:1 on --primary). --selected-surface and --selected-surface-hover are color-mix(--primary 14%/20%, transparent) tints, so they inherit whatever surface sits underneath.

--brand-ink 亮色 #8F4E00／暗色 #ffa33f —— 品牌橘鋪在非橘底上當文字／icon 用的可讀版本（對 card／sidebar／tint 皆 ≥5.7:1）。--selected-ink 是它的語意別名。--on-primary 兩個主題都定在 #171717（對 --primary 9.02:1）。--selected-surface 與 --selected-surface-hover 是 color-mix(--primary 14%/20%, transparent) 的淡染，會自動貼合底下任何底色。

Faint ink (2026-08-09)

最低階墨色（2026-08-09）

--faint-ink = color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted-foreground) 72%, transparent) — one step quieter than the floor text token. --muted-foreground is already the site's quietest ink, so anything softer has to step it down in opacity. Mixing with transparent rather than a surface color means it keeps the same step of dimness on any background — and it therefore goes darker in the dark theme and lighter in the light theme on its own, with no per-theme override. Consumers: --column-head-ink (table headers, below) and the value of a source-locked field (field-source-tag.css).

--faint-ink ＝ color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted-foreground) 72%, transparent) —— 比最低階文字 token 再輕一階。站上最安靜的墨色就是 --muted-foreground，比它更輕的角色只能以它為基底調降不透明度。混 transparent 而不是某個面色，所以它坐在任何底上都是同一階暗度——也因此**在黑夜版自動更深、在白天版自動更淡**，不需要逐主題各寫一次。消費者：--column-head-ink（表頭，見下）與來源鎖定欄位的值（field-source-tag.css）。

--locked-field-ink = color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted-foreground) 55%, transparent) — one step below --faint-ink, reserved for the value of a source-locked field. It is a separate token rather than a dimmer --faint-ink because that one also inks 10 table-header components, which are not meant to fade. Its contrast is deliberately below AA (measured: dark #606061 on #1C1D1E = 2.69:1, light #AFAFAC on white = 2.20:1). That holds only because it carries a disabled read-only value, not information the page is asking you to read — the field label and the "From bookyay" source tag keep normal contrast and are what answer "what is this, and why can't I edit it". Do not use it for text meant to be read.

--locked-field-ink ＝ color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted-foreground) 55%, transparent) —— 比 --faint-ink 再輕一階，專給來源鎖定欄位的值。之所以另立一個 token 而不是把 --faint-ink 調更淡：那一支同時是 10 支表頭元件的墨色，表頭並沒有要跟著變淡。對比刻意低於 AA（實測：深色 #606061 對 #1C1D1E ＝ 2.69:1、亮色 #AFAFAC 對白 ＝ 2.20:1）。成立的前提是它只承載 disabled 的唯讀值、不是本頁要讀的資訊——欄位標籤與「bookyay 帶入」來源標記都維持正常對比，「這格是什麼、為什麼不能改」由那兩個回答。不要拿它去寫需要閱讀的文字。

Column header ink (Q41, 2026-07-31)

欄位表頭墨色（Q41，2026-07-31）

--column-head-ink = var(--faint-ink) (2026-08-09; the recipe itself moved up to --faint-ink when a second consumer appeared — value and behaviour unchanged) — the label ink for every list/table column header. There is no text token darker than --muted-foreground (light #6E6E68 / dark #979797 are already the floor), so it steps that down in opacity instead. It exists as a token because the same role had been running three recipes (bare --muted-foreground, color-mix(…68%, --card), color-mix(…72%, transparent)) — exactly the ad-hoc greys Q9 set out to collapse. Mixing with transparent rather than --card keeps the same step of dimness on any surface, including the four headers that carry a --muted fill. Consumed by 10 header components.

--column-head-ink ＝ var(--faint-ink)（2026-08-09 起；出現第二個消費者時把配方上收成 --faint-ink，值與行為不變）—— 所有列表／表格欄位表頭的標籤墨色。站上沒有比 --muted-foreground 更暗的文字 token（亮 #6E6E68／暗 #979797 已是最低階），所以以它為基底調降不透明度。收成 token 是因為同一個角色原本跑了三種配方（裸 --muted-foreground、color-mix(…68%, --card)、color-mix(…72%, transparent)），正是 Q9 要收斂的「散落的即席灰」。混 transparent 而非 --card，表頭坐在任何底色上（含四支帶 --muted 底的）都是同一階暗度。消費者＝ 10 支表頭元件。

Status ink pairs

狀態墨色配對

Saturated status fills often fail AA as text (--status-warning alone is 1.42:1 on white). Each status color gets a same-hue "-ink" variant reserved for text/icon use — fill stays fill, ink stays ink.

飽和的狀態填色當文字用時常不過 AA（--status-warning 單獨對白只有 1.42:1）。每個狀態色都配一支同色相的「-ink」版本，專供文字／icon 使用——填色歸填色、墨色歸墨色。

status-warning-ink#8A6D00
status-accent-ink#6D28D9

--status-warning-ink — light #8A6D00 (4.92:1 on white) / dark var(--status-warning). --status-accent-ink — light #6D28D9 / dark var(--status-accent); used by .badge--accent.

Scrollbar · --scrollbar-* (2026-07-27)

捲軸 · --scrollbar-*（2026-07-27）

Site-wide custom scrollbar, defined once (not per-theme) — color derives from color-mix(var(--foreground) …%, transparent), which already flips with theme on its own. Mixing into transparent rather than a surface token is deliberate: the same scrollbar sits on the sidebar rail, white modals, dark cards, and the solid-orange hero card, and baking in one surface's color would leave a stain on the others.

全站自訂捲軸，只定義一次（不分主題）——顏色由 color-mix(var(--foreground) …%, transparent) 推導，本來就會跟著主題翻。混 transparent 而非某個 surface token是刻意的：同一支捲軸會出現在側欄軌、白色 modal、深色卡、甚至實色橘的 hero 卡上，混死某個面就會在其他面上烤出色斑。

1.2 Typography

1.2 字體

Foundation holds only the raw type tokens — font (--font-*) · size (--fs-*) · weight (--fw-*) — rendered as a matrix so you can read them directly. No usage here: which token maps to H1, body, button… lives in Pillar 2 · Role.

Foundation 只放原始字型 token —— 字體（--font-*）· 字級（--fs-*）· 字重（--fw-*） —— 以矩陣直接呈現。這裡不講用途：哪個 token 對應 H1／body／button… 在 Pillar 2 · Role。

Three-layer cascade — _tokens.css declares a Latin-first base (Geist / Inter / Geist Mono + plain Noto Sans TC); it is kept only as the pre-rebrand fallback tail. ds-components/fonts.css loads after it and fully re-declares --font-display / --font-ui / --font-body / --font-cjk / --font-cjk-display with Satoshi first for Latin and LINE Seed TW / Chiron Hei HK first for CJK, and owns every @font-face — so the effective stack is whatever fonts.css sets, not what _tokens.css shows. Headings resolve through --font-cjk-display (LINE Seed TW → Chiron Hei HK → Noto Sans TC); body/UI resolve through --font-cjk (Chiron Hei HK → Noto Sans TC) — LINE Seed TW's thick geometric strokes clog dense CJK glyphs below display size, so it is reserved for large headings only.

三層疊法——_tokens.css 宣告的是拉丁優先的舊版 base（Geist／Inter／Geist Mono ＋ 單純的 Noto Sans TC），現在只當改版前的備援尾巴留著。ds-components/fonts.css 排在它之後載入，完整重新宣告 --font-display／--font-ui／--font-body／--font-cjk／--font-cjk-display，拉丁換成 Satoshi 打頭、中文換成 LINE Seed TW／昭源黑體打頭，並持有全部 @font-face——所以實際生效的是 fonts.css 這份宣告，不是 _tokens.css 裡看到的那份。標題走 --font-cjk-display（LINE Seed TW → 昭源黑體 → Noto Sans TC）；內文／UI 走 --font-cjk（昭源黑體 → Noto Sans TC）——LINE Seed TW 是粗筆畫幾何字面，密筆中文字在小於標題的字級會糊成一塊，所以只保留給大字級標題。

1.5 Shadow · Elevation ladder (E0–E4)

1.5 陰影 · 海拔階梯（E0–E4）

Flat by default — a shadow means one thing only: this element is temporarily floating above the page. Five fixed rungs, each bound to a fixed set of components. Separation between same-level elements never uses shadows (use hairline / surface tints). Interaction = borrow the next rung's token (card hover → float; no ad-hoc hover shadows). Higher = larger offset/blur but restrained alpha, so lift stays soft and flat-feeling.

預設扁平——陰影只有一個意思：這個元素暫時浮在頁面之上。固定五階、每階綁定固定元件；同層元素之間永遠不用陰影分隔（用髮絲線／surface 色階）。互動＝借上一階 token（card hover → float，不自創 hover 陰影）；越高位移與暈開越大、濃度反而收斂，浮起但不厚重、保住扁平感。

Rung階TokenValue數值Who lives here誰住這裡

--shadow-header

Utility: .edge-shadow — turns --shadow-header into an edge shadow shown only below an element: content-width (inset), tapered/faded at both ends, never leaking on top/sides. A same-height, inset, bottom-rounded layer (::before) casts the shadow, then clip-path reveals only the part below the element — no opaque cover needed. Tunable via --edge-shadow-inset (28px) / --edge-shadow-radius (64px). Faithful to Figma 720:1763's two-layer structure. Used by the wizard header (.wizard__top, built-in) and the E-Shop page-top stock bar; add class="edge-shadow" to reuse (host must be positioned — sticky/relative).

工具：.edge-shadow — 把 --shadow-header 變成「只露下緣」的邊緣陰影：內容寬（內縮）、兩端漸淡收尾、上緣與兩側都不外漏。作法是一個與元素等高、內縮、下方圓角的圖層（::before）投陰影，再用 clip-path 只露出元素下方那段——不需另做不透明上層遮蓋。可調 --edge-shadow-inset（28px）／--edge-shadow-radius（64px）。忠實照 Figma 720:1763 的兩層結構。wizard header（.wizard__top，內建）與電子商店貼頂庫存條已用；其他元素加 class="edge-shadow" 即可覆用（host 需為已定位元素：sticky／relative）。

1.7 Iconography

1.7 圖示

Tabler icon set (@tabler/icons 3.45.0), registered in icons.js and injected per page via ztorIcons.applyIcons(). Thin 1.2px outlined glyphs as inline SVG (no icon font). New icons must be added to the registry first.

Tabler 圖示集（@tabler/icons 3.45.0），註冊於 icons.js，各頁透過 ztorIcons.applyIcons() 注入。細 1.2px 描邊字符，以 inline SVG 呈現（不用 icon font）。新圖示必須先加進 registry。

Two files, deliberately split — do not merge. js/icons.js (~36KB, 139 curated glyphs) is the product-page registry loaded by all 30 pages. js/icons-all.js (~1.7MB, the full Tabler set: 5,112 outline + 1,054 filled, auto-generated) is loaded only by this page, and must come before icons.js so the missing keys get merged in. To use a new glyph on a product page, add it to the icons.js registry — never ship the full set.

兩檔分工（刻意設計，勿合併）：js/icons.js（~36KB，策展 139 顆）＝產品頁 registry，30 頁都載、保持輕量；js/icons-all.js（~1.7MB，完整 Tabler 6,166 顆＝outline 5,112＋filled 1,054，自動生成）只有本頁載，且必須排在 icons.js 之前，才能把缺的 key 併進 registry。產品頁要用新圖示，一律走「補進 icons.js registry」，不掛全集。

Registry keys keep their pre-migration names. When the set moved from Lucide to Tabler on 2026-07-21, every key kept its old name (trash-2, more-horizontal, check-circle…) and the data-lucide attribute was left alone, so all 2,630 references across 39 pages needed no edit. The trade-off is an attribute name that no longer matches the icon set; renaming it to data-icon is a separate one-off mechanical pass, not something to bundle with an icon-set swap.

registry key 沿用換庫前的舊名：2026-07-21 由 Lucide 換成 Tabler 時，key 一律保持舊名（trash-2、more-horizontal、check-circle…），data-lucide 屬性名也沒動，因此 39 頁、2,630 處引用完全不用改。代價是屬性名與圖庫名不一致——這是拿命名整潔換零改動風險；日後要正名成 data-icon，走獨立的一次性機械改名，別跟換圖庫混在同一輪。

1.8 Theme mode

1.8 主題模式

Light + dark + system. <html data-theme> driven by theme.js, persisted in localStorage["ztor.theme.preference"]; follows prefers-color-scheme when set to system. Toggle top-left. Dark uses translucent white overlays on a near-black canvas. See Pillar 3.

淺色 + 深色 + 跟隨系統。由 theme.js 驅動 <html data-theme>，狀態存於 localStorage["ztor.theme.preference"]；設為系統時跟隨 prefers-color-scheme。切換鈕在左上角。深色模式在接近全黑的 canvas 上疊半透明白。詳見 Pillar 3。

1.9 Grid / Layout

1.9 網格／佈局

12-col bento, 1280px max-width centered (opt-in .page--narrow variant caps at 1056px for two-column detail pages), 24px gutters (16px ≤900px). Topbar 64px sticky; section rhythm 80–96px; full-bleed Dashboard hero; pure-black footer slab.

12 欄 bento，最大寬 1280px 置中（選用變體 .page--narrow 收成 1056px，供兩欄詳情頁用），24px gutter（≤900px 時 16px）。頂列 64px sticky；區塊節奏 80–96px；Dashboard hero 滿版出血；純黑頁尾色塊。

1.10 Imagery

1.10 影像

Full-bleed photographic hero on the Dashboard (centered radial veil keeps white copy ≥5:1). Elsewhere imagery is functional: IP cover art, product thumbnails, creator avatars. Data shows through the chart family, not decorative illustration.

Dashboard 採滿版攝影 hero（中央放射狀遮罩讓白字維持 ≥5:1）。其他地方的影像都是功能性的：IP 封面、商品縮圖、創作者頭像。資料靠圖表家族呈現，不用裝飾性插畫。

02 · Role

From raw values to design decisions.從原始數值到設計決策

Semantic roles assign each Foundation value a job. Components reference these, so a token swap re-themes the whole system.

語意角色替每個 Foundation 數值指派一份工作。元件引用的是角色，所以換一組 token 就能替整個系統重新換膚。

This layer is organised as six categories — 2.1 Color · 2.2 Typography · 2.3 Spacing · 2.4 Control sizes · 2.5 Elevation · 2.6 Cross-component rules. Every renderable role is shown live. Light values live here (the role default); dark overrides live in Pillar 3.

本層分六類 —— 2.1 顏色 · 2.2 字體 · 2.3 間距 · 2.4 控件尺寸 · 2.5 陰影 · 2.6 跨元件規則。可渲染的角色都即時畫出來。這裡放亮色（角色預設）；深色覆寫在 Pillar 3。

Names shadcn lacks (app-shell two layers, named primary-hover, extra status hues, brand gradient) are kept as [ext]. Swatches below are light values — dark is Pillar 3.

2.3 Spacing

2.3 間距

Spacing runs on the Pillar 1 --sp-* px-named scale — component gap / padding / margin reference the primitive directly, the same pattern as font sizes using --fs-*. No semantic spacing-role layer yet (component/layout-level names): that is the honest status — roles get named when real, consistent usage groups emerge, never invented up-front (the fictional --gap-* set was removed 2026-06-30). Literal exceptions: odd optical tweaks, off-scale 22/26px, negatives, calc(); fan-store.css pending (parallel edit).

間距走 Pillar 1 的 --sp-* px 直命名刻度——元件 gap／padding／margin 直接引用 primitive，與字級用 --fs-* 同一模式。語意間距 role 層（component/layout 級命名）仍未建立：這是誠實現況——等真實一致的用途分群出現才命名，不預先杜撰（虛構的 --gap-* 已於 2026-06-30 移除）。保留字面值的例外：奇數微調、刻度外 22/26px、負值、calc()；fan-store.css 因並行編輯待補。

2.4 Control sizes

2.4 控件尺寸

Buttons + form controls share one height scale (all multiples of 4) so an input and a button at the same size line up. Drive heights from --control-h-*; never hard-code.

按鈕與表單控件共用一套高度級（全部 4 的倍數），同尺寸的 input 與 button 對齊。高度一律走 --control-h-*，不寫死。

--control-h-xs · 28
--control-h-sm · 36 ★ 單行控件預設
--control-h-md · 44
--control-h-lg · 52 （待採用）
--control-h-xl · 60 （待採用）

2026-07-21 (Q25): the real default for single-line controls is --control-h-sm (36) — md is only labelled "default" at the scale level. Before Q25 .input was padding-driven (39px) while .btn was 36px, so "equal-size controls align" was aspirational; per-component padding tweaks had also grown three mismatched search boxes (41.5 / 37.5 / 35.5). Single-line controls now all take height: var(--control-h-sm); never size a new control with padding — padding×2 + font-size×line-height almost always lands on a fraction. .textarea stays padding-driven with min-height.

2026-07-21（Q25）：單行控件的實際預設是 --control-h-sm（36），md 只是刻度層被標為 default。Q25 之前 .input 靠 padding 撐開＝39px、.btn 是 36px，「同尺寸等高」只是文件宣稱；各元件自行調 padding 還長出 41.5／37.5／35.5 三種對不齊的搜尋框。現在單行控件一律 height: var(--control-h-sm)；新增控件不要用 padding 湊高度——padding×2 ＋ font-size×line-height 幾乎必然算出小數。.textarea 例外，維持 padding ＋ min-height。

2.5 Elevation

2.5 陰影

Elevation roles follow the Pillar 1 E0–E4 ladder: one component, one rung; interaction borrows the rung above (card hover → float); shadows never separate same-level elements. Content surfaces top out at E2 Card — E3/E4 are reserved for transient layers (dropdowns, dialogs). The hero is the only deeply-lit surface and it does that with a gradient veil, not box-shadow.

層級角色依 Pillar 1 的 E0–E4 海拔階梯：一元件一階；互動借上一階（card hover → float）；同層元素之間永遠不用陰影分隔。內容表面最高到 E2 卡片——E3／E4 保留給暫時性浮層（下拉、對話框）。只有 hero 是重打光的表面，且靠漸層遮罩、不是 box-shadow。

E2 --shadow-card

E3 --shadow-float
dropdown / tooltip下拉／tooltip
E3 --shadow-lift-flat
list row hover / drag (no rim)清單列 hover／拖曳（無 rim）
E4 --shadow-overlay

Frosted-overlay recipe: modal backdrops pair --overlay-tint (darkening wash) with --overlay-blur (backdrop blur) — e.g. .payout-modal.

毛玻璃浮層配方：modal 背景以 --overlay-tint（壓暗）搭 --overlay-blur（背景模糊），如 .payout-modal。

2.6 Cross-component rules

2.6 跨元件規則

These are principles every component obeys, not a token scale — rendered as live mini-demos.

這些是每個元件都要遵守的原則，不是 token 刻度——用小型 live 示例呈現。

① Focus 環

One recipe across every control + both modes — outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px (list rows use -2px inset). No per-component outline vs box-shadow drift.

全控件、兩模式單一配方 —— outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px（清單列用 -2px 內嵌）。不再各元件各寫各的。

② Surface 分層對比

A component is seen by the contrast of its fill / border / shadow against the layer it sits on; a fill the same colour as the background disappears. White fills need a 1px border to form on white; for cross-layer safety use a real border, not fill-as-edge. Build any filled component against its layers and verify on the darkest one. (Button white/grey example: §4.2.)

元件靠「填色／邊框／陰影跟所在那層的對比」被看見，填色和背景同色就會消失。白填要靠 1px 邊框在白底成形；要跨層安全就用實線 border，別用「填色當邊」。做任何有填色的元件，對它所在的層做、並在最深那層目視驗證。（按鈕白/灰底實例見 §4.2。）

white on white · no border → vanishes白填白底 · 無邊 → 消失
+ 1px border → forms＋1px 邊 → 成形

③ Primary 保留用途

--primary (orange) is only for primary CTA, brand mark and hero accent. Info banners, nav active, KPI highlights and status pills use neutral or semantic tokens.

--primary（橘）只用於主要 CTA + 便利貼 + 品牌標記 + hero 強調。絕不用在 nav active、KPI 高亮或狀態 pill——那些用 --muted/--accent。

✓ CTA · 便利貼 · 品牌標記 · hero   ✗ nav active · KPI · status pill

04 · Component

Concrete, importable UI units.

可直接匯入的具體 UI 單元。

Each component references Pillar 2 Roles (not raw Pillar 1) and ships either as a dedicated ds-components/ file or as a documented product-owned component in shared.css / feature CSS. Every unit carries a _layer tag (🟢 atom / 🟡 molecule / 🟠 organism), orthogonal to its variants.

每個元件都參照 Pillar 2 Role（不直接用 Pillar 1），並以獨立 ds-components/ 檔或已文件化的 product-owned component（shared.css／feature CSS）形式存在。每個單元都帶一個 _layer 標籤（🟢 atom／🟡 molecule／🟠 organism），與其變體相互獨立。

Component card order元件卡閱讀順序Purpose用途
1 · PurposeWhat job the component owns; why it exists.這個元件負責什麼工作；為什麼存在。
2 · RelationshipsBuilt from ↓ means child components. Used by ↑ means parent components.由哪些元件組成 ↓ 是子元件；被哪些元件使用 ↑ 是父元件。
3 · Rendered previewWhat the component looks like in use. Variations and interactions are shown inside the preview, not as separate reading categories.直接看這個元件實際長什麼樣。樣式差異與互動變化放在預覽裡，不再拆成多個閱讀分類。
4 · SpecificationSource, anatomy, behavior, token usage, classes, and evidence / usage.來源、內部結構、行為、token 使用、class，以及實際頁面證據／用法。

4.0 Classification

Two orthogonal axes. Layer (atom → molecule → organism → template) tells you how big a unit is. Component vs Pattern tells you whether it's a thing you import (Pillar 4) or a recipe you follow (Pillar 5).

兩條互相獨立的軸。Layer（atom → molecule → organism → template）告訴你一個單元有多大。Component vs Pattern 告訴你它是可匯入的東西（Pillar 4）還是依循的配方（Pillar 5）。

Preview discipline (2026-07-08) — a component's Rendered preview shows one instance of the component itself (as a variant × state matrix where meaningful). Any demo that assembles multiple distinct components is labelled In context and links to the matching Pillar 5 pattern card; assembly rules (what sits above what, order, rhythm, triggers) live in Pillar 5 only, never duplicated in a component section. Litmus test: "would this rule still hold if this component's CSS were deleted?" — if yes, it's a pattern, not the component.

展示判準（2026-07-08）——元件段的視覺展示只展示該元件的單一實例（有意義時做成變體 × 狀態矩陣）。凡是把多個不同元件組起來的示範，一律標「實際情境 In context」並連到對應的 Pillar 5 pattern 卡；組合規則（誰在誰上、順序、節奏、觸發時機）只寫在 Pillar 5，元件段不重複。判斷句：「把這個元件的 CSS 刪掉，這條規則還成立嗎？」成立 → 它是 pattern，不是這個元件的。

LayerLayerDefinition定義Examples範例
🟢 atomSingle indivisible UI primitive不可再分的單一 UI 基本元件Button · Badge · Status dot · Chip · Switch · Info banner · Input · Icon · Meta cell
🟡 molecule2–4 atoms cooperating on one job2–4 個 atom 協作完成一件事NavigationMenu · Card · KPI · Alert · Accordion · Tabs · Cookie banner · Empty stub · Selection card · Composer · Dropdown menu · Page intro · Field system · Filter row · Segmented control · Stepper · Settings nav · Settings row · Rental card · Rank bars
🟠 organismA complete page region一個完整的頁面區塊Header · Footer · Data list · Table · Chart · Bento grid · App shell · Wizard frame · Hero slideshow · IP hero · Chart card

How the three layers nest — an edge appears only when a component's own CSS/markup actually renders the child (verified against ds-components/*.css, not visual resemblance). Many controls here are bespoke rather than reusing the Button/Input atoms — a system gap worth closing. Chips are clickable.

4.2 Button

🟢 atom

Purpose

用途

Primary action control. Five emphasis levels — pick by how important the action is and how dense the surface is. One orange primary per block (card / dialog / toolbar); never use the orange primary for destructive actions.

主要動作控制項。五種強度——依「動作多重要」與「版面多密」挑。每一塊（卡片／彈窗／工具列）只留一個橘 primary;刪除類動作絕不用橘色 primary。

When to use which

什麼時候用哪個

“One block” = a self-contained area on screen (a card, a dialog / form, a toolbar, a list row) — not the whole page.

「一塊」＝畫面上各自獨立的一塊區域（一張卡片、一個彈窗／表單、工具列、列表的一列），不是整頁。

Variant變體Emphasis強度Use where用在哪Per block同一塊可放幾個
--primary 橘填strongest CTA最強 CTAthe one most important action這一塊裡最重要的那一個1 max最多 1 個
--outline 白底＋線框secondary次要content area; needs a clear edge (Back / Cancel)內容區、要明確邊界（Back／Cancel）any number幾個都行
--soft 灰填無框secondary, quieter次要、更安靜toolbars / dense rows (Export)工具列／密集列（Export）any number幾個都行
--ghost 透明low低強調inline / auxiliary, no weight行內／輔助、不搶版面any number幾個都行
--icon / --icon-circleoperation純操作icon-only (close / search / settings)只有圖示（關閉／搜尋／設定）—

Outline vs Soft = whether it has a border: white content area wants an edge → outline; toolbar / dense area wants quiet → soft. No destructive variant yet — add .btn--danger when needed; don't use orange primary for delete.

Outline vs Soft＝要不要框：白內容區要邊界 → outline；工具列／密集區要安靜 → soft。目前無紅色 destructive 變體——需要時補 .btn--danger;刪除別用橘 primary。

On which background (white vs grey)

配哪種底色（白底 vs 灰底）

A button is seen by the contrast of its fill/border against the surface — a fill the same colour as the background disappears. So pick by the surface layer it sits on (ramp: white --card → grey --muted/--surface-shell/--sidebar).

按鈕靠「填色／邊框跟背景的對比」被看見——填色和背景同色就會消失。所以要看它坐在哪一層 surface（階梯：白 --card → 灰 --muted/--surface-shell/--sidebar）。

Sits on坐在哪OK能用Avoid別用
White (card / route page / dialog / form)白底（卡片／route page／彈窗／表單）primary · outline · soft · ghost · icon—
Grey (app shell / muted panel / table / rail)灰底（app shell／muted 面板／表格／rail）primary · outline · ghost · iconsoft (grey-on-grey vanishes) → use outlinesoft（灰填在灰底會不見）→ 改 outline

In short: soft is white-surface only; on grey use outline. Outline has a real border, so it holds on both — the safest cross-layer secondary.

一句話：soft 只活在白底；要放灰底就改 outline。 outline 有實線框，白灰底都成立，是跨層最安全的次要。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Keep one orange primary per view as the clear CTA.
  • 每個畫面只保留一個橘色 primary 當明確的 CTA。
  • Use outline / ghost for secondary and inline actions.
  • 次要與行內動作用 outline／ghost。
Don't別做
  • Put more than one primary in a region, or use orange for destructive actions.
  • 同一區塊放多個 primary,或用橘色做破壞性動作。
  • Use a transparent-fill outline on the white canvas — it reads as "nothing there."
  • 在白底上用透明填色的 outline — 看起來像「什麼都沒有」。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Let the soft-tag fill colour carry the status — no dot needed.

Don't別做

  • Invent ad-hoc status colors — use the 5 variant tokens.
  • 別自創臨時的狀態顏色 — 用那 5 個變體 token。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Keep exactly one .chip--active per group at a time.
  • 每個 group 同時只保留一個 .chip--active。
  • Use .chip--static when a chip is informational, not a filter.
  • 當 chip 只是資訊性、不是篩選時，用 .chip--static。
Don't別做
  • Use a chip to display non-filterable status.
  • 別用 chip 顯示不可篩選的狀態。
  • Put more than one active chip in a single-select group.
  • 別在單選 group 裡放超過一個 active chip。
  • Render an action (Export / Print) as a chip — that's a Button.
  • 別把動作（Export／列印）做成 chip —— 那是 Button。

🟢 atom

Purpose

Brand marks are the one exception to "Tabler only" — brand-apple / brand-google / brand-facebook / brand-line come from Simple Icons (CC0), because each vendor's trademark guidelines pin the exact shape of its mark and Tabler's redrawn versions don't match. Same 24×24 grid, single-colour, fill="currentColor" stroke="none" — no brand colour values enter the site.

品牌標記是「只用 Tabler」的唯一例外——brand-apple／brand-google／brand-facebook／brand-line 取自 Simple Icons（CC0），因為各家商標規範綁死了標記的形狀，Tabler 的重畫版對不上。同樣是 24×24 網格、單色、fill="currentColor" stroke="none"——站上不會出現品牌彩色值。

Filled glyphs are scoped, never global — the site's default is outline. *-fill keys exist only where a filled shape is doing a specific job: the dashboard alert cards (alert-triangle-fill, info-fill, check-circle-fill, x-circle-fill) and the login page's F1 method cards (mail-fill, smartphone-fill — from Tabler filled/mail and filled/device-mobile, added 2026-08-04 so the two account methods carry the same visual weight as the four brand marks beside them; brand marks have no outline form). The outline mail and smartphone keys are untouched — smartphone is still the login-device row in settings.html, and mail is referenced by partials/artist-picker.js (a component no page currently loads). Adding a filled variant anywhere else is a style decision — see STYLE-DECISIONS Q51.

Trial batch — the all-filled dashboard (2026-08-04, not adopted) — eleven more *-fill keys (layout-grid-fill, banknote-fill, receipt-fill, flag-fill, award-fill, tag-fill, bell-fill, lock-fill, calendar-fill, circle-fill, globe-fill) exist only for the side-by-side page demo-icons-filled.html. No product page references them. That page is a copy of index.html plus one alias script that repoints the outline registry keys at their filled twins, so the whole screen — sidebar nav and JS-rendered cards included — turns filled without editing index.html, js/sidebar.js or js/components.js. No <g transform> scaling: measured, Tabler’s filled shapes run exactly 1px wider per side than their outline twins (to offset a 2px stroke); at our 1.2 stroke that leaves the filled version only 4–6% larger, matching how the four alert fills already ship. Eighteen glyphs on that page have no filled form in Tabler at all (menu, x, rocket, landmark, chevron-down, chevron-right, shopping-bag, ticket, users, search, package-x, upload, megaphone, trending-up, dollar-sign, refresh-ccw, bar-chart-3, link) and stay outline — nothing was hand-drawn to fill the gap, so the demo is deliberately a mix. Delete both the page and this batch if the trial is rejected.

實心字符只給特定情境，不是全站選項——站上預設是描邊。*-fill 只存在於實心真的在做事的地方：儀表板告警卡（alert-triangle-fill／info-fill／check-circle-fill／x-circle-fill），以及登入頁 F1 的方式卡（mail-fill／smartphone-fill，取自 Tabler filled/mail 與 filled/device-mobile，2026-08-04 新增，讓兩張帳號方式卡與旁邊四顆品牌標記同一個視覺量級；品牌標記沒有描邊版）。描邊的 mail 與 smartphone 原封不動——smartphone 仍是 settings.html 的登入裝置列，mail 由 partials/artist-picker.js 引用（該元件目前沒有頁面載入）。要在其他地方新增實心變體屬風格決策，見 STYLE-DECISIONS Q51。

試做批次：儀表板整頁實心（2026-08-04，尚未採用、尚未裁決）——另外 11 顆 *-fill（layout-grid-fill／banknote-fill／receipt-fill／flag-fill／award-fill／tag-fill／bell-fill／lock-fill／calendar-fill／circle-fill／globe-fill）只服務比較用示範頁 demo-icons-filled.html，正式頁面一顆都沒引用。該頁是 index.html 的複本，唯一差別是多掛一段別名腳本把 registry 的描邊 key 指到實心版，因此在不動 index.html、js/sidebar.js、js/components.js 的前提下，整頁（含側欄導航與 JS 動態渲染的卡片）都會換成實心。這批不加 <g transform> 縮放：量過幾何邊界，Tabler 的實心版剛好比描邊版每邊各大 1px（用來補償 stroke-width 2 的一半），站上 stroke-width 是 1.2，所以實心版視覺上只大 4–6%，與既有四顆告警實心的做法一致。首頁另有 18 顆字符 Tabler 根本沒有實心版（menu／x／rocket／landmark／chevron-down／chevron-right／shopping-bag／ticket／users／search／package-x／upload／megaphone／trending-up／dollar-sign／refresh-ccw／bar-chart-3／link），一律維持描邊、不手工描一顆假的，所以示範頁必然是實心與描邊混排——那正是要給使用者判斷的東西。裁決不採用時，示範頁與這批 key 一起刪除。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Pair with Field system for label + error message.
  • 搭配 Field system 顯示 label 與錯誤訊息。
  • Use .input--with-prefix when a fixed leading glyph (currency, unit) sits inside the field.
  • 欄位內有固定前置符號（幣別、單位）時用 .input--with-prefix。
  • Rely on the component's 1px --border shadow edge; do not add a second border.

  • Use .select--bare only when the select has no card/section ancestor (2026-07-26 rule: border is reserved for controls sitting inside a card/section).
  • 只有 select 不在任何卡片／section 內才用 .select--bare（2026-07-26 新規則：border 只留給疊在卡片／section 內的控件）。
Don't別做
  • Invent a size variant — the real component ships one size only.
  • 別自創尺寸變體 — 真身元件只有一種尺寸。
  • Use .select--bare inside a card/form-section — it needs the 1px edge to read as a field there.
  • 別在卡片／form-section 內用 .select--bare — 那裡需要 1px 邊線才讀得出是欄位。

State gap: aria-invalid (error ring) styling is still not implemented in input.css.

4.13 Control row

單塊外框盒 （--plain／__body--top，2026-08-10）

.control-group--plain is the group with no switch row and no reveal — just an outlined box with its own padding, for grouping content that needs a visible edge. First use: the ticket step of create-event, one box per date, so you can tell which tickets belong together once there are several. With a single date the box drops entirely (2026-08-10, per user) — the frame's job is telling tickets from different dates apart, and there is nothing to distinguish when every ticket belongs to the same date. .control-group__body--top drops the top divider for when the reveal is the only block in the group.

.control-group--plain 是「沒有開關列、也沒有揭示區」的版本——就是一個帶內距的外框盒，用來把需要看得出邊界的一塊內容圈起來。首個用途：建立活動票務那一步，一個場次一個框，門票一多才看得出哪幾張屬於同一場。只有一場時整個框撤除（2026-08-10 使用者指示）——框的職責是把不同場次的門票分開，全部門票都屬於同一場時沒有要分辨的對象。.control-group__body--top 用在「揭示區是群組裡唯一一塊」的情形，收掉那條沒有東西可分隔的上緣線。

4.13b Field more

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

Collapses the secondary fields of a group behind a full-width outlined "Show more" button, so the form opens with only the field people fill every time. First used by Create product ▸ Delivery method ▸ Shipping, where only Weight stays out and Shipping category / Dimensions / Pickup location fold away. It auto-expands when any collapsed field already has a value — Product detail is an edit page carrying real data, and collapsing filled fields would hide the creator's own input. That check is why this is JS rather than a plain <details>.

把一組欄位裡的次要欄位收在「顯示更多」按鈕後面，讓表單第一眼只剩每次都要填的那個。**按鈕＝滿寬線框鈕**（2026-07-21 使用者裁示，原為靠左的無框文字鈕）：外觀重用 Button atom 的 .btn.btn--outline，本元件只擁有「滿寬＋置中」與表單節奏（margin-bottom: --sp-16，:last-child 歸零）這幾件版面事，不自己刻邊框與 hover。首次用於建立商品 ▸ 取貨方式 ▸ 物流配送：只留「重量」在外，出貨分類／尺寸／寄件地收起來。收合區內只要有任何欄位已經有值就自動展開——商品明細是編輯頁、欄位帶著真實資料，照樣收起來等於把使用者填過的東西藏起來。就是為了這個判斷才用 JS，而不是單純的 <details>。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Keep the one field people fill every time outside the fold.
  • 把每次都要填的那個欄位留在收合區外。
  • Let the auto-expand handle edit pages — same markup, no page-specific branch.
  • 編輯頁交給自動展開處理，兩頁共用同一段 markup、不必分岔。
Don't別做
  • Fold away a field the creator must fill to publish without saying so — required fields inside stay marked *.
  • 別把上架必填的欄位藏起來卻不說明——收在裡面的必填欄仍保留 * 標記。
  • Use it to hide a whole feature; this is field density, not permissions.
  • 別拿它藏功能；這是欄位密度，不是權限。

4.15 Upload tile

🟢 atom

Video slot (--video, 2026-08-10)

影片投放格 （--video，2026-08-10）

The one and only way to take a video upload on this site (user ruling). It carries the ratio of the thing it holds — 16:9, not a bar unrelated to its content — and takes two thirds of the container so a single trailer drop zone does not outweigh the form around it. Default and hover are inherited from the base tile, so every droppable slot on the site feels the same. Consumers: create-event, create-project, project-detail, publish-work (two).

站上影片上傳的唯一做法（使用者裁決）。比例照它要裝的東西走——16:9，不是一條與內容無關的長條；寬度取容器的 2/3，一支預告片的投放區才不會比整份表單還搶眼。default 與 hover 直接吃基底，站上「可投放的上傳格」因此只有一種手感。消費頁：create-event、create-project、project-detail、publish-work（兩處）。

Upload a trailer MP4 or MOV · up to 2 GB

Purpose

用途

Dashed upload affordance for create flows (spec 5.1.5.2 Show it off / Prove it's real / digital download). 2026-08-09 (user ruling): portrait image slots have exactly one component and one layout rule — .upload-assets.upload-assets--fill plus the container-level [data-upload-reveal]. Every image slot still shares the single portrait ratio set in 2026-07-31 (--upload-img-ratio: var(--img-portrait, 2 / 3), Foundation token --img-portrait, see Pillar 1 §1.3), applied through the --portrait modifier. Retired the same day: --hero, .upload-grid / --2x2, .upload-showcase / --stacked — the whole “hero is bigger than the thumbs” model, along with the rounded icon chip --hero used to carry (Q18). A hero now says so with .upload-tile__flag instead of by being larger. Still in service: --file for file-drop bars and --16x9 for landscape media slots (project-detail's Demo video/audio). Title uses __title, constraints (size / file types) go in __hint. 2026-08-09: .upload-assets--fill sizes tiles from how many fit a full row — --upload-asset-cols (4 by default) splits the container width between that many tiles and lets --portrait derive the height, so four tiles always fill one row exactly, a fifth wraps at the same size, and the whole set scales with the column instead of needing breakpoints (2 columns at ≤640px); pair it with [data-upload-reveal] on the container to keep exactly one empty tile on screen. Same day, second round (user direction): the empty state's __sub/__hint are now hidden with display instead of opacity, so the resting state and the hover state each centre on their own content height; a __flag on an interactive tile waits until the image is actually in; an optimized tile swaps its third hover button for Back to the original; and an empty tile's dashed border thins to 0.5px on hover.

建立流程用的虛線上傳格（spec 5.1.5.2 展示它／證明是真的／數位下載檔）。2026-08-09（使用者裁決）：直式上傳圖只有一套元件、一套排版規則——.upload-assets.upload-assets--fill 加容器層的 [data-upload-reveal]。比例仍是 2026-07-31 定下的單一直式（--upload-img-ratio: var(--img-portrait, 2 / 3)，Foundation token --img-portrait，見 Pillar 1 §1.3），由 --portrait 修飾詞套用。同日退場：--hero、.upload-grid／--2x2、.upload-showcase／--stacked——「主圖比附圖大」整個模型連同 --hero 專屬的圓角晶片圖示框（Q18）一起收掉。主圖改用 .upload-tile__flag 自報身分，不靠尺寸暗示。仍服役：檔案投放列的 --file、橫式媒體槽的 --16x9（project-detail 的 Demo 影片／音樂）。主文案放 __title，限制（尺寸／檔型）放 __hint。2026-08-09 新增 .upload-assets--fill：格子尺寸改由「一排放幾格剛好撐滿容器」決定——--upload-asset-cols（預設 4）把容器寬度平分給那幾格、高度由 --portrait 推導，所以四格永遠撐滿一整列、第五格換行且尺寸相同，容器變寬變窄等比縮放（≤640px 降為一排兩格）；容器再加 [data-upload-reveal] 就變成一次只露出一個空格。同日第二輪（使用者指示）：空狀態的 __sub／__hint 改用 display 收放（不再是 opacity），靜止態與 hover 態各自依自己的內容高度置中；互動格的 __flag 等圖真的進來才掛；優化完成後 hover 的第三顆鈕換成「還原成優化前」；還沒填的格子 hover 時虛線收細成 0.5px。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • State the constraint (min size / file types) in __hint — never leave a bare tile.
  • 限制（最小尺寸／檔型）寫進 __hint——別留光禿禿的格子。
  • Use registered Tabler icons, never literal ＋ text.
  • 使用已註冊的 Tabler icon，不用文字 ＋。
  • Use --hero for the single primary slot, the grid for secondary angles.
  • 主要單格用 --hero，次要角度用縮圖列。
Don't別做
  • Use it as a generic empty-state box — that's empty-stub.
  • 別當一般空狀態容器用——那是 empty-stub。
  • Solid borders or filled backgrounds; dashed border is the affordance.
  • 別改實線或填色背景；虛線就是可上傳的訊號。

data-upload-src / data-upload-keyEdit-flow preload: data-upload-src="<url>" puts the tile straight into .is-filled with that image, skipping the fake-upload timer. data-upload-key identifies the tile in the upload:change event (falls back to data-cp-asset).編輯態預填：data-upload-src="<url>" 讓格子直接帶圖進 .is-filled、跳過假上傳計時；data-upload-key 供 upload:change 事件辨識該格（沒有則退回 data-cp-asset）
upload:changeCustom event, bubbles, fired on every state change — detail: { key, filled, state }. Pages listen to this to update readiness gating; state (empty / uploading / processing / filled / optimizing / optimized) is what lets a page say which stage it is at, since filled alone only answers "usable or not".自訂事件，會冒泡，每次狀態變動都會發出——detail: { key, filled, state }。頁面監聽它來更新就緒判斷；state（empty／uploading／processing／filled／optimizing／optimized）讓頁面講得出「現在是哪一段」，光靠 filled 只回答得了「能不能用」
Keyboard鍵盤Empty tiles get role="button" + tabindex="0" (removed once filled — the two real <button> actions take over the tab stop); Enter/Space activate (Space doesn't scroll the page); focus ring is the site standard outline: 2px solid var(--ring); focus is handed back after upload/optimize/remove completes, but only for keyboard-triggered interactions. When a tile has no __title, the injected label depends on the mode (2026-08-07): image tiles fall back to cp.media.add (Add image), content-file tiles to cp.cfile.add (Add file) — a video or subtitle slot labelled “Add image” misleads screen-reader users. A page can name its own slot precisely (“Add the trailer”) with aria-label + data-i18n-aria-label; the component gives way.空狀態掛 role="button"＋tabindex="0"（填圖後拿掉，改由動作列兩顆真 <button> 進 tab 序）；Enter／Space 觸發同點擊（Space 不捲頁）；焦點環用站上標準 outline: 2px solid var(--ring)；上傳／優化／刪除完成後把焦點交還，僅限鍵盤觸發的互動。沒有 __title 時自動補的標籤依模式分兩種（2026-08-07）：圖片格用 cp.media.add（新增圖片）、內容檔格用 cp.cfile.add（新增檔案）——影音或字幕格套「新增圖片」會誤導螢幕閱讀器使用者。頁面要更精確的說法（「上傳預告片」）就自己寫 aria-label＋data-i18n-aria-label，元件會讓路

4.15b Bundle editor

🟠 molecule

Purpose

用途

Editor for co-creation reward bundles and presale plans (2026-08-03, D166 — same card, presale just turns off revenue-share). 2026-07-30: behavior extracted into a shared module, js/bundle-editor.js (window.ZtorBundleEditor.mount()) — now 4 consumers (create-project's "Reward bundles" step + its new "Pre-order plans" step, and project-detail's 方案與承諾 › 支持方案 + 預購方案 tabs) render the exact same card from one source instead of diverging implementations. 2026-08-03: new shares option (default true; presale mounts pass false) drops the revenue-share slots field entirely, drops the "Auto" sell-cap option (leaving only Unlimited/Limited — "Auto" is derived from the slot pool, which presale has none of), and changes isValid() to require a name plus either an item or a non-empty perk (co-creation instead requires a name plus either an item or slots > 0, since presale has no slots to serve as consideration). Everything else — name, one-line description, product picker, perks, discount, computed price — is identical between the two and shares the same cpp.bd.* copy keys. 2026-07-30 (third pass): the discount is a percentage (0–100%, .amount-field--suffix.amount-field--readonly unit %) rather than a dollar amount, and the expanded card's field order was reorganized input-to-output: name*, one-line description, included revenue-share slots + an auto/limited sell-cap toggle, a product-reference picker (.fc-pick → .fc-ref, no free-text items), free-text perks (.fc-perk), then a dedicated pricing block (.fc-pricing) at the very end. It's a read-only computed field (.amount-field--readonly) — slot count × per-slot price + item prices — plus the bundle-discount % that can only reduce the item portion, floored at the slot-share value (a slot's price can't be discounted away); the cap is likewise expressed as a percentage (maxPct()). Typing past what the items can absorb doesn't get silently clamped: the hint below the field turns red (.field__hint.fc-hint--over) and says what actually applied. The collapsed summary shows the struck-through original price (.fc-sum__was) whenever a discount is in effect, so the discount survives collapsing. The card's left-edge "incomplete" stripe has been removed by user decision — isValid() is unchanged and still drives the page-level coach marks and Continue gating, only the card's own visual cue is gone. 2026-07-30 (fifth pass, user decision): the expanded price moved to the head's top-right corner — a small label .fc-sum__tag ("Bundle price") plus an enlarged value .fc-sum__val (--fs-20), because the pricing block sits at the very bottom of the card, five field groups away from where a creator is actually editing slots or items. Actions moved from the head to the card foot in the expanded state — the head's top-right is now price-only; the foot holds a full-width clickable collapse handle .fc-collapse (with a chevron-up icon) and, below it, .fc-bundle__foot containing a solid .btn--destructive remove button (only shown when more than one card exists). The collapsed state is unchanged — actions stay as text links in the head. Card padding now matches create-product's .form-section--outlined rhythm (user-specified reference): --sp-24 instead of --sp-16/--sp-18, including the collapsed row so the name doesn't shift horizontally between states; field labels inside the body are --fs-14 with hints pulled tight underneath.

共創回饋套組與預購方案的編輯器（2026-08-03，D166——同一張卡，預購只是關掉分潤）。2026-07-30：行為抽成共用模組 js/bundle-editor.js（window.ZtorBundleEditor.mount()）——現在共 4 個消費點（create-project「回饋套組」步驟＋新增的「預購方案」步驟、project-detail 方案與承諾 › 支持方案＋預購方案 兩個分頁）從同一個來源畫出同一張卡，不再是會慢慢分岔的實作。2026-08-03：新增 `shares` 選項（預設 true；預購掛載傳 `false`）整格關掉分潤名額欄位、拿掉販售上限的「自動」（只留不限量／限量——「自動」是從名額池推導的，預購沒有池子）、並把 `isValid()` 改成「有名稱 ＋（至少一件商品或一項有內容的權益）」（共創版是「有名稱 ＋（至少一件商品或名額數 > 0）」，因為預購沒有名額可以當對價）。其餘（名稱、一句話說明、商品挑選器、額外權益、優惠、算出來的價格）兩型完全相同、共用同一批 `cpp.bd.*` 文案。2026-07-30（第三批）：優惠欄位改百分比（0–100%，沿用既有 .amount-field--suffix.amount-field--readonly 做法，單位 %），不再是金額；展開態欄位順序同輪重排為「輸入到結果」：套組名稱＊、一句話說明、含分潤名額＋自動／限量販售上限切換、商品「引用」挑選器（.fc-pick→.fc-ref，不接受自由文字品項）、自由文字額外權益（.fc-perk），最後才是獨立的定價區塊（.fc-pricing）。價格為唯讀自動計算（.amount-field--readonly）——名額數 × 每名額單價 ＋ 商品定價加總——套組優惠只能折抵商品那一段，地板是股份總價（名額不可被折），上限同樣以百分比表達（maxPct()）。填超過商品能吸收的上限不會被默默截掉：欄位下方的提示會轉紅（.field__hint.fc-hint--over）並說出實際生效的折抵值。收合摘要列在有折扣生效時會顯示劃線原價（.fc-sum__was），折扣不會因收合而消失。卡片左緣的「未完成」色線已依使用者裁決移除——isValid() 判準沒變，仍驅動頁面教練提示與 Continue 擋關，消失的只是卡片自己的那條視覺表現。2026-07-30（第五批，使用者裁決）：展開態價格移到標題列右上角——小標 .fc-sum__tag（「套組價」）＋放大的金額 .fc-sum__val（--fs-20），因為定價區塊在卡片最後、隔著五組欄位，編輯名額或商品的當下看不到價格變成多少。動作同輪從標題列移到卡片底部——展開態標題列右上角只留價格；底部改放整條可點的收合把手 .fc-collapse（含 chevron-up 圖示）與下方的 .fc-bundle__foot（內含實色 .btn--destructive 移除鈕，僅多於一張卡時出現）。收合態不變，動作仍是標題列的文字連結。卡內間距同輪對齊建立商品頁 .form-section--outlined 的節奏（使用者指定參考對象）：內距由 --sp-16/--sp-18 改 --sp-24（含收合列，收合↔展開時名稱不左右位移）；卡內欄位 label 改 --fs-14、說明貼齊 label。

AnatomyBundle card (.card.fc-bundle) = head (.fc-bundle__head → .fc-sum summary row [__name + numbered .fc-bundle__index · __meta (hidden when expanded) · __price, whose content depends on state — collapsed: plain amount with struck-through original via .fc-sum__was when a discount applies; expanded (2026-07-30 fifth pass): right-aligned .fc-sum__tag label ("Bundle price") + optional .fc-sum__was + enlarged .fc-sum__val (--fs-20)] + .fc-bundle__actions **only rendered when collapsed** — edit/remove text links; when expanded the head shows price only and actions move to the card foot) + body (.fc-bundle__body, hidden when .fc-bundle--collapsed), fields ordered input-to-output (2026-07-30 third pass): name*, one-line description, slots/availability .form-grid 2-col (.segmented auto/limited + .fc-slotnote/--over hint; the grid's own bottom margin is patched via .fc-bundle__body > .form-grid), product picker .fc-pick (__results popover → __opt/__opt-price/__empty) resolving to reference rows .fc-ref (__thumb 44px/__name/__meta), free-text perks .fc-perk, then a dedicated pricing block .fc-pricing at the very end (top border, extra top margin) — .fc-pricing__row 2-col (112px discount-% field + 176px .fc-pricing__out read-only computed price, tabular-nums at --fs-15) + a full-row .field__hint.fc-pricing__note (two lines: composition, then cap/over-limit). Full-width tall add button .fc-add (56px, add bundle); .fc-add-item (48px) is reused for "add perk" in this generation. 2026-07-30 (fifth pass): two exits at the card foot, expanded state only — a full-width clickable collapse handle .fc-collapse (a <button>, chevron-up icon + label, top border) followed by .fc-bundle__foot (right-aligned) holding a solid .btn.btn--destructive.btn--sm remove button, shown only when more than one bundle card exists (same condition the collapsed head's remove link already used). The card has no invalid-state visual — the former left-edge .fc-bundle--invalid stripe was removed 2026-07-30 by user decision; isValid() itself (name present, and either slots > 0 or ≥1 item) is unchanged and still drives page-level gating.
Behavior / usageStyle + behavior, not style-only: js/bundle-editor.js exposes window.ZtorBundleEditor.mount({ list, addBtn, t, getPool|poolInput|pool, getPerSlot|perSlotInput|perSlot, initial, collapsedByDefault, shares, onChange }), returning { getBundles, setBundles, add, ensure, render, refresh, isValid, listPrice, finalPrice, maxDiscount, maxPct, perSlot, maxUnits, autoUnits, committedSlots, pool, num }. 2026-08-03 (D166): new shares option (boolean, default true; presale mounts pass false) — co-creation and presale plans are the same object, the only difference being presale carries no revenue share. With shares:false: the revenue-share slots field is not rendered at all; the sell-cap toggle drops "Auto" (which is derived from the slot pool) and offers only Unlimited (internal value unlimited) / Limited (co-creation's non-limited internal value is auto — the two generations deliberately use different strings so the state itself says whether a cap was derived or genuinely absent; every check is written as "is it limited", never "is it auto"); the price breakdown drops the slots line, leaving only the item total; and isValid() becomes "name present, and either at least one item or at least one non-empty perk" (co-creation requires a name plus either an item or slots > 0 — presale has no slots to serve as consideration, so a perk-only plan like "one livestream meet-and-greet" must still be valid). Everything else (name, one-line description, product picker, perks, discount %, computed price) is identical and shares the same cpp.bd.* copy. Spec source: documents/5.1.2.1-建立專案流程.md §5.3.2 F28/F29, decisions.md D166. The revenue-share slot pool is injectable three ways (a live getter, an input element to read, or a fixed number) so the same module serves a page where the pool changes live (create-project, reading #fd-slots) and a page where it's fixed (project-detail, a SLOT_POOL prototype constant derived from fund.goal ÷ 200). 2026-07-30: per-slot price is injectable the same three ways — create-project reads the funding step's read-only #fd-perslot (goal ÷ supporter slots), project-detail derives a fixed fund.goal ÷ 200 (prototype constant, no real per-slot-price field upstream yet). Pricing rule: list price = slots × per-slot price + sum of item prices. 2026-07-30 (third pass): the discount field is a percentage (0–100, .amount-field--suffix.amount-field--readonly) of the list price, not a dollar amount — final price = list price − min(discount% × list price, item total), so the discount can never eat into the slot-share value; its ceiling expressed as a percentage is maxPct() = floor(item total ÷ list price × 100) (a pure-reward card with 0 slots can discount to $0; a slots-only card with no items can't discount at all — maxPct() is 0). refresh() re-syncs every card in place (no re-render, no focus loss) whenever the injected pool or per-slot price changes externally. "Auto" sell-cap derives sellable units from the shared pool; "Limited" is a manual hard cap. Product references resolve against window.ZTOR_PRODUCTS via js/products-store.js; there is no free-text item entry in this generation. 2026-07-30 (fifth pass) rule: actions live in exactly one place per state — the head's text links when collapsed, the foot's collapse handle + destructive button when expanded — never both, so the head's top-right corner is free for the price in the expanded state. Reuses .card, .field, .form-grid, .input, .amount-field, .amount-field--readonly, .segmented, .btn. Prototype: no persistence, no real inventory/order linkage.

4.16b Combobox

🟡 molecule

Multi-select search-to-add typeahead. Reuses the Tag input field (selected .chip--removable + borderless entry); focusing / typing opens a floating .combobox__menu of suggestions (grouped .combobox__opt = icon + name + meta), picking one adds it as a chip and drops it from the list. 4.17 Variant builder

🟠 organism

Shopify-style Variations for Create product (spec 5.1.5.2 §4.1④, physical only). A .segmented switches Single ↔ Multiple; in Multiple the builder shows option rows and every value combination becomes a priced & stocked row. Configured options collapse to a one-line summary; only the one being edited expands. 2026-07-21: values are one .input per value (edit in place) instead of chips — the common act is fixing a typo, which chips force you to delete and retype. The whole set sits inside a Nest, so its rows are layer 3 and carry depth with a 1px border rather than a third fill (Q24); the two "add" buttons use a dashed border, the established "nothing here yet, press to grow one" vocabulary. The Limited edition (§4.1⑤) adds the Total-quantity column via .variant-table--limited. Editable cells reuse .input. The table box hugs its content width and left-aligns (width:fit-content + max-width:100%) instead of stretching the form column, and the Variant column sizes to content (max-content, 110px floor) rather than a stretchy fr (2026-07-16). 2026-07-21: the Stock column is a read-only readout (.variant-cell--stock), not an .input — stock rises only through a logged restock; a variant under the low-stock threshold adds .variant-cell--stock-low and turns --destructive, so "which variant is running out" reads off the table at a glance.

建立商品的 Shopify 式多選項（規格 5.1.5.2 §4.1④，僅實體）。.segmented 切單一／多選項；多選項時顯示選項列，每個值的組合自動成為一列、各有價格與庫存。設定好的選項收成一行，只有正在編輯的那組展開。2026-07-21：值由 chip 膠囊改成「一個值一個 .input」、可就地改字——設定選項時最常做的是改一個字，chip 模式得先刪掉再重打。整組坐在 Nest 裡，所以這些列是第三層，依 Q24 用 1px 邊框而非再疊一階填色承擔層級；兩顆「新增」鈕用虛線邊框，是站上「這裡還沒有東西、按了會長出來」的既有語彙。限量版本（§4.1⑤）以 .variant-table--limited 多出上限欄。可編輯格重用 .input。2026-07-21：庫存欄改成唯讀讀數（.variant-cell--stock）——庫存只能靠留有紀錄的補貨增加；低於低庫存門檻的規格加 .variant-cell--stock-low 轉 --destructive，讓「哪一個規格快沒了」在表上一眼可見。

規格

Sourceradio-card.css + segmented.css
Anatomy.segmented.radio-cards > .segmented__btn (marker via ::after) > .radio-card__text (title + sub).
Behavior / usage2-up grid (gap 12); flat 1px --border card, no shadow (Q13 2026-07-16, aligned to Figma node 781-4386); active = small centered orange dot (no ring, no card outline); unselected shows no marker. Single-line cards (no .radio-card__sub) vertically center the text + dot; title+sub cards stay top-aligned. Optional .radio-cards--icon swaps the dot for a supplied .radio-card__icon; JS still reuses Segmented toggle. Hover (2026-08-09, per user) — every radio card lifts its background to color-mix(--foreground 6%, --accent) on hover. That fill used to be declared only inside --gate, leaving the plain cards with no hover feedback at all; they are the same component, the only difference being a lead icon. The orange dot stays gate-only: the gate has no persistent selection so its hover dot is the preview of what you'd pick, whereas a plain card already shows a dot on the selected one and a second dot under the cursor would read as "both are selected". align-items: stretch (2026-08-09 root-cause fix) — side-by-side cards used to come out different heights whenever one card's sub-copy wrapped to more lines than its neighbor (e.g. a 3-up "取票方式" row). Grid's own default for align-items is already stretch, but segmented.css's .segmented { align-items: center } (specificity 0,1,0) was never overridden: .segmented.radio-cards (0,2,0) is higher-specificity as a selector, but it never set align-items itself, so the browser fell through to the lower-specificity rule that did — turning the grid's stretch into center, so each card sized itself to its own content. Fixed by declaring align-items: stretch explicitly on .segmented.radio-cards.

Amount field

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

A money input with a unit affix — normally a static read-only symbol ($ prefix, or a right-side % / months suffix). Built on Input, using an absolute-positioned prefix so it sits flush on the shadow-hairline field. The affix can also be an interactive unit toggle (the button + chevron shown below); that path shipped for the cash/POPCORN pricing unit, which was removed (spec 5.1.5.2 · D144), so no page uses the toggle today — the chrome is kept as a reusable capability. --suffix moves the affix to the right for units like % or months; --hero is a large, single-focus size for a modal's headline amount.

4.24b Review row

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

Flat, no-card wizard Review-step summary: field/section name + value with a right-side "Edit →" action, rows separated by hairline dividers — no card chrome. Normalizes create-event.html's .ce-review-row, register-ip.html's .ri-summary, and create-project.html's flattened Review .card blocks (that page's 2026-06-25 comment already flagged this exact consolidation: "全頁無卡片化…這批歸第三批 review-row 設計判斷"). Use for a wizard's Review step; avoid for record lists (use Data list) and avoid wrapping rows in their own card — flat is the point.

流程 Review 步驟的無卡片摘要列：欄位／區塊名＋值，右側「Edit →」動作，列間 hairline 分隔——無卡片外框。正規化自 create-event.html 的 .ce-review-row、register-ip.html 的 .ri-summary、create-project.html 扁平化的 Review .card（該頁 2026-06-25 註解已預告這次收斂：「全頁無卡片化…這批歸第三批 review-row 設計判斷」）。用於流程的 Review 步驟；紀錄清單改用 Data list，也別把列各自包卡片——扁平就是重點。

Purpose

用途

Read-only key/value row: label left, value right, a hairline divider above every row but the first. For "look, don't touch" summaries — detail-page meta cards, status snapshots. Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Mark the first visible row of a group .kv--lead when conditional rows above it may be [hidden] — a hidden row still counts as :first-child, so the automatic first-row rule fires on the wrong row.
  • 當上方有條件列可能被 [hidden] 隱藏時，把該組第一個「看得見」的列標 .kv--lead——被隱藏的列仍算 :first-child，自動首列規則會落在錯的列上。
  • Cap the value width yourself (max-width on .kv__v) when values can be long — the component sets no width ceiling.
  • 值可能很長時自行加寬度上限（在 .kv__v 上加 max-width）——本元件不預設寬度上限。
Don't別做
  • Don't put an input, switch, or button in .kv__v — an editable value belongs in a .field.
  • 別在 .kv__v 裡放 input、switch 或按鈕——可編輯的值屬於 .field。
  • Don't rely on the browser's default hidden behavior: .kv is display:flex, which beats it, so .kv[hidden] must zero display explicitly (the component already does — don't override it back).
  • 別依賴瀏覽器對 hidden 的預設行為：.kv 是 display:flex 會蓋過它，所以 .kv[hidden] 必須顯式歸零 display（元件已內建——別再覆寫回去）。

4.25 Table

🟠 organism

Header cells have neither a background nor a bottom rule (2026-07-31, two calls the same day) — a filled header inside a card reads as a second block, and the rule went next so every list header across the site matches (STYLE-DECISIONS Q41). Whitespace carries the separation; each tbody row keeps its own rule. Companion classes: .ztor-table-scroll (horizontal scroll wrapper; inside a .card the table drops its own frame so you do not get a box in a box), .ztor-table__nowrap (short-value columns; without it a two-character word breaks one glyph per line), .ztor-table__sub (second line under the main column for source / module / category — saves a whole column of width), .ztor-table--truncate (modifier: every cell stays on one line; the name cell takes the leftover width via max-width:0 + width:100% so overlong text is ellipsised instead of widening the table), .ztor-table__mediatext (wrapper for a two-line name inside .ztor-table__media). Always put the thumbnail inside the name cell via .ztor-table__media — a column of its own pays the 20px cell padding on both sides, leaving the image adrift in an empty column. Thumb is 40px with a --sp-12 gap; 40px equals the row's content height, so row height is unchanged.

表頭沒有底色、也沒有下框線（2026-07-31 同日兩段裁決）——在卡片裡填底色會讀成另一個區塊；下框線則是為了讓全站列表表頭一致（見 STYLE-DECISIONS Q41）。分隔改由留白承擔，tbody 每一列的分隔線不動。伴生類：.ztor-table-scroll（橫向捲動容器，坐在 .card 內時表格會取消自框、避免框中框）、.ztor-table__nowrap（短值欄不換行，否則兩個字的詞會被逐字斷成直行）、.ztor-table__sub（主欄位下的第二行，放來源／模組／分類這類歸屬資訊，省下一整欄寬度）、.ztor-table--truncate（modifier：整張表一律單行，主欄位用 max-width:0 ＋ width:100% 吃掉剩餘寬度，過長文字以點點點收掉而不把表格撐寬）、.ztor-table__mediatext（.ztor-table__media 內要放兩行文字時的包裝）。縮圖一律用 .ztor-table__media 併進名稱格、不要自成一欄——獨立欄會在圖兩側各吃一次 20px 內距，圖會浮在空欄中間。縮圖 40px、間距 --sp-12；40px 等於資料列的內容高，列高不變。

Purpose

用途

Self-framed data table (1px border + rounded surface) with muted header row, hairline row dividers, and check/cross/partial status cells. 2026-07-25 (Q29) converged the frame only to match variant-table (own border instead of shadow); spacing/type stay roomy (padding 16/20, header 13, body 14). Flush inside a .card the card frames it (table border suppressed); standalone/inset tables keep their own border. Use when ≥3 data columns need aligned comparison (Earnings transactions, feature-comparison grids); avoid for single icon+body+amount rows — use .data-list.

自帶 1px 邊框的資料表（圓角 surface），含淡化的 header 列、髮絲線列分隔，與 check／cross／partial 狀態格。2026-07-25（Q29）只收斂邊框對齊 variant-table（自帶邊框取代陰影）；間距／字級維持原樣較鬆（padding 16/20、表頭 13、內文 14）。直接坐進 .card（flush）時由卡出框、表格自身邊框取消；獨立／inset 表格保留自身邊框。當 ≥3 個資料欄需要對齊比較時使用（Earnings 交易、功能比較表）；單純 icon+body+金額的列別用 — 改用 .data-list。

4.26 Product list

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

Borderless inventory table for E-Shop: product identity (image / thumb + title + meta) + category + price + status + stock + visibility switch + edit action, on row-divider layout. The E-Shop page swaps column layouts per panel via page-level modifiers — --eshop (Products: image / category / price / status / stock / visibility), --bundles (Bundles: image / members / bundle price / stock), --auctions (Auctions: image / category / bid / activity) — all layered on the same base grid. Below 760px the header hides and rows restack. 2026-07-31 user: .product-list__image turned portrait (76×94, width unchanged, height from --img-portrait) — real product photos now render uncropped instead of a square crop of the portrait original. Exceptions: 2026-08-05 (D176 / Q52): ratio value changed to 2 / 3 (76×114, row 154) and the events square exception was dropped — .product-list--events .product-list__image no longer overrides, so all eight list thumbnails now share one ratio with no exception. the pickup page's .product-list__thumb QR icon-chip is a different class and is unaffected. 2026-08-04 pinned section (.product-list__divider + .product-list__pin-mark, spec 5.1.5 F4 / D172) — rows pinned to the front of the fan-facing shop sit above a labelled divider carrying a n/10 count; membership is position, so dragging a row across the divider is what pins or unpins it. No fan-facing "featured" badge: the creator-side cue is the section plus a small pin glyph before the name, which is the only cue left whenever the divider is hidden. 2026-08-05: the divider now holds in every filter and search state (it used to collapse the moment either was active). Filtering only hides non-matching rows, so what stays on screen is still "pinned above, rest below" — the visibility test is therefore "can this view see any pinned row", not "is a filter active". None visible → the whole divider collapses, since a rule reading "pinned above" with nothing above it would lie. The count keeps reporting the panel-wide n/10 quota. The --empty invitation box, by contrast, shows in every filter state (pinning belongs to the list, not to the "All products" view, and "filter to live, then pick a few to feature" is a normal path) — with nothing pinned there are no two sections to divide, so nothing can be misread. Only its action link collapses when the current view holds no pinnable row (a draft-only filter), since it would otherwise be a button that does nothing. With nothing pinned yet the divider stays visible, switches to its --empty variant (a rounded 1px box instead of a single rule — with nothing above it, it invites rather than divides) and swaps to a prompt — "Pin items to the top." with the right-hand slot swapped from the n/10 count to a borderless .btn--ghost action (__divider-cta) — sitting exactly where the pinned section will appear. The link guides rather than acts: it scrolls the first pinnable row into the upper third, opens that row's action menu and rings the Pin entry with .dropdown__item.is-hinted (§4.26); choosing what to pin stays with the creator.

E-Shop 的無框庫存表：商品識別（圖／縮圖＋標題＋meta）＋分類＋價格＋狀態＋庫存＋可見度開關＋編輯動作，列分隔線版式。E-Shop 頁以頁面層修飾子按分頁切換欄位版型——--eshop（商品：圖／分類／價格／狀態／庫存／可見度）、--bundles（套組：圖／成員／套組價／庫存）、--auctions（競標：圖／分類／出價／動態）——都疊在同一 base grid 上。760px 以下表頭隱藏、列重新堆疊。2026-07-31 使用者：.product-list__image 改直式（76×94，寬度不變、高度由 --img-portrait 推導）——真實商品照不再被裁成方形。例外：2026-08-05（D176／Q52）：比例值改 2 / 3（76×114、列高 154），同時撤除活動的方形例外——.product-list--events .product-list__image 的覆寫已刪除，八支清單縮圖現在沒有例外、全部同一個比例；取貨頁的 .product-list__thumb QR icon chip 是不同 class，不受影響。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Use Badge variants for status and Switch for visibility — no bespoke pills.
  • 狀態用 Badge 變體、可見度用 Switch — 不另刻 pill。
  • Extend columns with a page-level modifier (like --eshop), not by editing the base grid.
  • 用頁面層修飾子（如 --eshop）擴充欄位，不直接改基本 grid。
  • On --eshop, the whole row navigates to Edit on click (2026-07-23, same pattern as Orders/Creators rows) — resolve the destination from that row's own kebab "Edit" <a href>, don't duplicate the draft-vs-created branching logic in a second place.
  • --eshop 整列點擊導向編輯（2026-07-23，比照 Orders／Creators 列的既有模式）——導頁目的地讀該列 kebab「編輯」的 <a href>，別在別的地方另外複刻一份草稿／已建立的判斷邏輯。
Don't別做
  • Don't use it for transaction ledgers — use Table for dense numeric grids.
  • 交易流水帳別用 — 密集數字表格用 Table。
  • Don't put borders around rows — the system look is row-divider only.
  • 別給列加外框 — 系統樣貌只用列分隔線。
For developers — classes · tokens · code給工程師 — class · token · 程式碼

橫向捲動包層 .product-list-scroll（2026-08-06，八個消費頁全數套用）：清單列有 7–9 欄、最窄 830–1160px，而 app 外殼的 .main 是 overflow-x: hidden——視窗一窄，右側的「狀態」「操作」幾欄會被切掉而且捲不到，每一列的 ⋮ 在那個寬度區間整個點不到（既有的 ≤760px 堆疊版型只救得了手機，760px 到各變體最小寬之間是漏的，筆電常見的 1280–1440 就落在裡面）。做法沿用站上既有的表格橫捲；min-width: min-content 讓清單撐到欄寬加總那麼寬，欄數少、放得下的變體不會長出捲軸。上下的 padding-block 是給 :hover 浮起陰影讓位（overflow-x 一旦不是 visible，overflow-y 也會被算成 auto），用等量負外距抵銷、版面高度不變。

Every identity field and status axis gets its own column (was: identity crammed in one cell, two .status-axes badges sharing one Status cell). The fulfilment column carries both delivery and pickup values — shipping uses To ship / Shipped / Completed, on-site pickup uses Awaiting pickup (orders.status.pickup); a mixed order shows both badges side-by-side, no wrap (__ship gap + nowrap, column minmax 148). The Contents column (__line) shows one item per line in white at the standard cell size (fs-13), lines spaced apart, clamped to 4 lines with an ellipsis. 4.27 Project list

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

Borderless table list for the Projects page. Shares Product list's visual DNA (real image thumbnail, row-divider, accent hover) but with project columns and whole-row links to the detail page. Columns: image · project (type above name + one-line desc) · current goal (smaller bold percentage, compact progress bar, then amount on three separate lines) · time left · category (content type over family) · status · chevron. Only funding / pre-order campaigns have a goal and countdown; every other kind shows an em-dash in those two columns. Below 1180px the secondary columns (time / category) drop; below 760px rows restack. (2026-07-24: the to-do tip column was removed; the goal cell gained its reusable progress bar; type moved into the project identity stack.) 2026-07-31 user: .project-list__image turned portrait (76×94, same recipe as .product-list__image) — width unchanged, height derives from --img-portrait; row height grows from 116 to 134.

Projects 頁的無框表格列表。與 Product list 同一套視覺 DNA（真圖縮圖、列分隔線、accent hover），但欄位是項目專屬、整列連進明細頁。欄位：圖片 · 項目（類型／名稱／一行簡介）· 當前目標（第一排小一級粗體百分比、第二排細進度條、第三排實際金額）· 剩餘時間 · 類別（內容類型疊家族）· 狀態 · chevron。只有募資／預購項目有目標與倒數，其餘類型這兩欄顯示破折號。1180px 以下收掉次要欄（剩餘時間／類別），760px 以下列重新堆疊。（2026-07-24：移除待辦 tip 欄，當前目標加入可重用進度條；類型併入項目識別區。）2026-07-31 使用者：.project-list__image 改直式（76×94，與 .product-list__image 同一套推導）——寬度不變、高度由 --img-portrait 推導，列高從 116 長到 134。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Keep the whole row as one <a> — the chevron is a hint, not the only target.
  • 整列維持單一 <a> — chevron 是提示，不是唯一點擊目標。
  • Show an em-dash in goal / time for kinds without a campaign, don't invent numbers.
  • 沒有募資的類型，目標／倒數顯示破折號，不要編造數字。
Don't別做
  • Don't nest buttons or other links inside the row link — the whole row is one target.
  • 別在列連結內塞按鈕或其他連結 — 整列是單一點擊目標。
  • Don't fork the row layout per page — extend with modifiers.
  • 別為單頁另刻列版式 — 用修飾子擴充。

4.90 List toolbar

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

The control skeleton at the head of a list page. It gathers what used to sit scattered across the page header, a tabs row, and a filter row — primary axis, search, view switch, primary CTA, secondary filters — into two fixed layers: a solid shell toolbar, then a transparent secondary filter row. Promoted 2026-07-23 from E-Shop's page-local .eshop-list-topbar when Projects became the second consumer.

清單頁頁頭的控制骨架。把原本散在頁頭動作群、tabs 列、篩選列的控制項——主軸切換、搜尋、檢視切換、主要 CTA、次要篩選——收成固定的兩層：實色殼層工作列，加一層透明的次要篩選列。2026-07-23 由電子商店頁內的 .eshop-list-topbar promote 而來，觸發點是 Projects 成為第二個消費者。

Why the shell has a fixed height

為什麼殼層要釘選高度

The active tab's orange underline sits on the bottom edge of .tabs__item. Only when the tabs stretch the full 58px does that underline land at the very bottom of the shell instead of floating mid-height — hence the fixed height plus align-items: stretch.

active tab 的橘色底線貼在 .tabs__item 下緣。只有讓 tabs 撐滿整個 58px，底線才會落在殼層最底部、而不是浮在中間——所以是固定高度加 align-items: stretch。

Not part of this component

不屬於本元件的部分

Sticky pinning depends on each page's scroll container height and stacking, so it stays in the page's own <style>: E-Shop pins both layers (status row at top: 74px = 58px shell + 16px collapsed margin); Projects does not pin.

貼頂由共用的 snap dock 提供：把工作列（選配狀態列）包進 .list-dock，殼要往下包住內容（sticky 只能在親層 box 裡移動），js/sticky-dock.js 會在執行期包出 .list-dock__bars 並用哨兵切換 .is-snapped。貼頂態＝上緣切平與外框連成一體、毛玻璃、收成一行。狀態列選配（2026-08-01）：只有分頁的工作列也能用（首例 earnings-sony.html）。

規格

4.31 Empty stub

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

Centered full-page block for two cases: (1) a route reserved but not built yet, signalling "this page is a stub" rather than a real empty state; (2) a page opened with an id that cannot be found (D154) — __mark reads ! and __refs carries one button back to the list. Avoid for a built screen with no data — use a real empty state there. Consumers: edit-event.html · event-detail.html · project-detail.html (2026-08-07) · publish-work.html (2026-08-07) · store-settings.html.

整頁置中的區塊，兩種用途：(1) 路由已保留但畫面還沒建，明確標示「這頁是 stub」，而不是真正的空狀態；(2) 帶了 id 卻查不到那筆資料（D154 裁決）——__mark 放 !，__refs 放一顆回列表的按鈕。已建置但沒資料的畫面別用 — 那裡要用真正的空狀態。消費頁：edit-event.html、event-detail.html、project-detail.html（2026-08-07）、publish-work.html（2026-08-07）、store-settings.html。

4.34 KPI

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

Flat metric tile: one uppercase label, one big display value, and a semantic delta or neutral meta line. Use for dashboard summary rows, earnings tabs, and page-header metric strips where one number per tile is the point. Avoid when the value needs a trend chart — use the Chart organism.

扁平的指標 tile：一個大寫 label、一個大型 display 數值，加上一條帶語意的 delta 或中性的 meta 行。用於 dashboard 摘要列、earnings tab、頁首指標帶等「每個 tile 一個數字」的情境。數值需要趨勢圖時別用 — 改用 Chart organism。

.kpi[hidden] explicitly resets display — the component is flex, which beats the UA default for [hidden]. Added 2026-07-30; before that, anywhere setting el.hidden on a KPI failed to hide it (e.g. event detail hiding metrics that do not apply to the event type).

.kpi[hidden] 已顯式歸零 display——元件本身是 flex，會蓋過瀏覽器對 [hidden] 的預設。2026-07-30 補上；在此之前凡是用 el.hidden 收 KPI 的地方都藏不掉（例如活動詳情要收起不適用於該活動類型的指標）。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Use .kpi__delta--neg for declines so red signals direction.
  • 下降時用 .kpi__delta--neg，讓紅色標示方向。
  • Choose .kpi__meta when the footnote is informational, not a change.
  • 當註腳是資訊性、而非變化時，選用 .kpi__meta。
Don't別做
  • Fill the tile orange — orange is reserved for the primary CTA; a selected metric is shown by position, not color.
  • 別把 tile 填橘 — 橘色保留給主要 CTA；被選取的指標靠位置呈現，不靠顏色。
  • Put more than one value in a single tile.
  • 別在單一 tile 放超過一個數值。

4.40 NavigationMenu

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

The canonical topbar nav item: either a plain link (no dropdown) or a group trigger that opens a mega-dropdown of icon + title + sub options. This is the single nav system — the shipped .app-topbar uses it, and the Header composes it. Use a group trigger when a section exposes several destinations (IP Bank / E-Shop / Fans); use a plain link for a single destination (Dashboard / Earnings).

標準的 topbar nav 項目:可以是純連結(無下拉),或是會展開「icon＋標題＋子標」mega-dropdown 的群組 trigger。這是**唯一**的 nav 系統 —— 出貨的 .app-topbar 用它,Header 組成它。一個區段要露出多個去處時用群組 trigger(IP Bank／E-Shop／Fans);單一去處用純連結(Dashboard／Earnings)。

Admin-layer variant (spec §4.1 / D086): on the Creator-Management roster the Tier-1 items render locked (.app-topbar__link--locked) behind a "Creator Management" marker; inside a creator workspace a back-to-roster icon (.app-topbar__back) sits BEFORE the logo, with a "Managing <creator>" chip (.app-topbar__context). Styling lives in shared.css; injected by sidebar.js per the active creator.

Admin 層變體（spec §4.1／D086）：Creator 管理名冊上，Tier 1 各項以鎖定態呈現（.app-topbar__link--locked），前面是「Creator Management」標記；進入某 creator 工作區後，logo 之前出現返回名冊 icon（.app-topbar__back）＋「管理中 <creator>」chip（.app-topbar__context）。樣式住 shared.css、由 sidebar.js 依活躍 creator 注入。

4.43b Detail rail

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

The two-column skeleton for a detail / edit page: an editable main column on the left (usually Tabs + tab panels) and a sticky read-only meta rail on the right that stays put across every tab. This section documents the shell itself — column ratio, sticky behavior, the single-column --full variant, responsive breakpoint. When to reach for this layout and what belongs in the rail are assembly rules, not component rules — see the Detail + persistent rail pattern card in Pillar 5.

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Keep the rail read-only — it is the "what you should know before you change something" column, visible from every tab.

Don't別做
  • Don't add per-card margin inside the rail — spacing is owned by the rail's gap, and Form section's sibling margin-top is deliberately zeroed here so the gap isn't doubled.
  • 別在右欄的卡上自行加 margin——間距由右欄的 gap 決定，Form section 相鄰卡的 margin-top 已在此刻意歸零，避免間距變成兩倍。
  • Don't document "which cards go in the rail" here — that's a Pillar 5 pattern decision, and duplicating it splits the source of truth.
  • 別在這裡寫「右欄該放哪些卡」——那是 Pillar 5 的 pattern 決策，寫兩份會讓真相分岔。

AnatomyOptional crumb (with optional back button) + title + lede (supporting copy, optional help link) + optional action cluster + optional page footnote.
Behavior / usageDefault / with actions; mobile title resolves to 32px; eyebrow pattern is retired. Back button (2026-08-02) — the 10 detail pages put .page-crumb__back (a .btn.btn--icon-circle.btn--sm wrapping chevron-left) as the first child of the crumb and add .page-crumb--back, which switches the crumb row to flex so the button sits on the baseline row. It is a real <a> pointing at the crumb's parent level, not history.back(): arriving from a bookmark or shared link leaves no history to pop, and a link keeps cmd-click / copy-address working. Two deviations from the plain atom are deliberate and scoped to this consumer: the crumb's a { color: inherit } would otherwise paint the glyph brand-orange and draw a hover underline under the SVG, so .page-crumb .page-crumb__back restores the standard --muted-foreground → --foreground icon-button pairing; and it runs frameless (background: transparent; border: 0, 2026-08-02 user ruling) — dropping only the frame would leave the atom's --muted fill, which shows as a grey disc in dark mode and disappears entirely against the light-mode white page, so the same button would look like two different things per theme. At rest it is just the chevron; the circle returns on hover via the atom's --accent background. The gap to the first crumb is --sp-16 rather than --sp-10 for the same reason: with no visible edge, the empty box around the glyph stops reading as space. Hidden under html[data-embed] (shared.css) because the detail-sheet overlay already carries its own "Back to X" — two back controls in one view force the user to work out which one goes where, and the crumb's is a full-page navigation that would swap the iframe while the overlay stays open. The action cluster is for controls that change data only (2026-07-31 ruling) and wraps (flex-wrap: wrap) if a wide control is placed there. Contextual help goes in .page-intro__lede as .page-intro__help — an inline accent link after the last sentence; it cannot be nested inside __sub because applyI18n replaces that node's innerHTML on language switch. .page-note is the page-level footnote (bookend to .page-crumb) for whole-page disclaimers.
