Rendered preview

視覺展示

About Showcase Monetization Review

Segmented variant (--segmented, 2026-08-10)

分段變體 （--segmented，2026-08-10）

One segment per step, so the seams land exactly on the step boundaries. Solid = done, tinted = the step you are on, empty = not reached. Set --steps (how many steps are visible) and --at (current step, 1-based) alongside --progress (the completed share). Without the modifier the track stays one continuous bar, so existing consumers are untouched. The optional __state line under each name spells the status out — a bar length alone cannot say which step is finished.

一步一段，縫的位置就是步驟分界。實色＝已完成、淡色＝你在這一步、空的＝還沒到。用法是在容器上設 --steps（看得到幾步）與 --at（現在第幾步，1 起算），--progress 仍是已完成的比例。沒加這個修飾類的消費頁維持一條連續長條、行為不變。名稱下方選配的 __state 把狀態直接寫出來——光靠一條軌道的長度說不出「哪一步做完了」。

BasicsDone DatesDone TicketsNot done PublishingNot done ReviewNot done

Specification

規格

Sourceprogress-stepper.css
AnatomyTrack + gradient fill (width = --progress) + step labels.
Label statesdefault / --done (clickable) / --current. Since 2026-08-10 the label is a flex box with its own padding so the hit area matches what looks clickable; --done and --current take an --accent hover, future steps do not. [hidden] is restored explicitly because display:flex beats the UA rule.
--anystepOptional; every step reachable (2026-08-10, per user: "these steps should all be clickable") — by default only --done and --current get pointer + hover, because the default click handler only allows going back to a completed or current step and moving forward goes through Next; a future step that looks pressable but isn't is worse than one that plainly isn't. Adding --anystep declares that the consuming page's click handler accepts a jump to any step, so the clickable affordance opens up for all labels. Both halves are required: the class alone gives you "looks pressable, does nothing"; the handler alone gives you "works, but nobody can tell". Skipped steps are already [hidden] and unaffected. First consumer: create-event.
Track3px (was 6px until 2026-08-10). --segmented splits it into one segment per step using --steps; --at marks the current segment. Current segment is neutral, not a diluted brand tint (2026-08-10, per user: "the translucent colour looks broken on step 1") — it used to be --primary at 28%, which over the dark track (#161718) mixes to a muddy brown that reads as an orange that failed to render, most visibly on step 1 where it is the only thing on the track. It is now color-mix(--foreground-muted 45%, transparent), so hue belongs to "done" alone and brightness only answers "where am I". The fill no longer animates on --segmented (2026-08-10, per user: "a bit of orange shows up on step 1") — the continuous track animates its width because the transition itself carries meaning (sliding from 40% to 60%); on a segmented track the fill only ever rests on a segment boundary, so the 350ms in between briefly paints a "half-filled segment" that never actually exists. It was most visible stepping back to step 1 (0% complete): a sliver of orange lingered at the track's left edge as the fill animated down to nothing, reading as a rendering glitch. transition: none and border-radius: 0 (the track's own pill radius + overflow:hidden already round both ends; a second rounding on a near-zero-width box draws a hairline at 2× DPR).
Label / track alignment2026-08-10, per user ("the step titles don't line up with the bar") — the base label row is space-between: first label flush left, last flush right, the rest sharing the slack, each as wide as its own text. The track is equal segments. Two different divisions can never agree. --segmented therefore lays its labels out on grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--steps), minmax(0,1fr)): one cell per segment, so the text starts exactly at the segment's edge and the hover fill covers exactly that segment. Non-segmented consumers keep space-between. Hover range corrected 2026-08-10 (per user: "the hover range looks broken") — the first attempt kept the base inline padding and cancelled it with an equal negative margin. The text lined up, but the hover box then ran 8px past its segment on each side, so the fill and the segment above it disagreed and the highlight read as half a column off. The negative margin is gone: the grid cell is already one segment wide, the label fills it, and the hover fill lands exactly on that segment (measured at 1440px, 5 steps: every label box matches its segment's x and width to 0px). Inline padding stays (2026-08-10, per user: "it needs left padding") — alignment is the box's job, guaranteed by the grid; the text then uses that padding to keep 8px off the box edge, or it would sit flush against the hover fill and read as cramped. Box flush to the segment, text breathing inside the box: the two do not conflict. Vertical padding is unchanged, so the hit area keeps its height (45px).
Token usage--gradient-brand, --muted, --fs-12, --muted-foreground/muted.

With two plain 1fr sides the title block (min-width:0 + ellipsis) could shrink to 0 while the right side could not, so a narrow viewport collapsed the left track and the title overflowed onto the stepper; the floor makes the stepper absorb the squeeze instead. 4.52b Stock bar

🟢 atom

Purpose

用途

A 5px horizontal quantity bar that says "how much is left" at a glance — stock level, usage ratio. Always pairs with the exact figure next to it (e.g. "3 / 50"): the bar carries the feel, the number carries the truth, and neither substitutes for the other. Thinner and simpler than the Completeness meter, which owns its own label + count header; this one is bare track + fill and expects the surrounding card to supply the wording.

5px 高的水平量條，一眼讀出「還剩多少」——庫存水位、用量比例。一定要搭配旁邊的精確數字（例如「3 / 50」）：量條負責體感、數字負責精確值，兩者不可互相取代。比 Completeness meter 更細更簡單——那支自帶標籤＋計數表頭，本元件只有軌道＋填充，文字由外層的卡提供。

In stock庫存31 / 50

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Pass the percentage as an inline style="width:N%" on .stock-bar__fill — it is data, not styling, so it belongs to the consumer page, and the component sets no width of its own.
  • 百分比用 inline style="width:N%" 寫在 .stock-bar__fill 上——那是資料不是樣式，屬於 consumer 頁；元件本身不預設寬度。
  • Always show the exact figure alongside the bar.
  • 量條旁一定要顯示精確數字。
Don't別做
  • Don't invent a third colour. The bar has exactly two states — normal and --low; anything finer is a product rule.
  • 別自創第三種顏色。量條只有兩態——正常與 --low；再細的分級屬於產品規則。
  • Don't decide the low threshold in CSS — where "low" begins is a product rule the consumer evaluates before adding the modifier.
  • 別在 CSS 裡決定低庫存門檻——「多低算低」是產品規則，由 consumer 判斷後才加上修飾子。

4.53 Store settings page

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

E-Shop store-level settings as a popup (store-settings.html, spec 5.1.5.5 / D035 / D067) opened from E-Shop F3 as an embed-modal iframe — no global nav / breadcrumb / page header (the modal frame owns the title + close); actions sit in a bottom submit bar (.ss-actionbar). IA: a persistent Storefront card on top — a Base44 / Facebook-style identity band (cover + overlapping logo avatar + shop name / URL / bio shown as text) with per-field click-to-edit in place (.ss-edit: read text ↔ inline input/textarea/select, ✓/Enter commits, ✕/Esc cancels). Brand assets are the cover + avatar (edited via their own buttons) — no separate upload tiles. Then three peer setting groups (Product display / Payment / Shipping) as tabs (one at a time), plus a See as fan split preview. The whole page fills the standard 1280px .page column like other pages (it is not a two-column detail page, so it does not take .page--narrow). This component adds the field types base controls don't cover — URL affix (.ss-url), $ amount affix (.amount-field), read-only Stripe card (.ss-status) — the drag-to-reorder list (.ss-order, fan-side order · F3 / D031) and the fan preview body (.ss-fan).

電子商店「商店層級設定」popup（store-settings.html，spec 5.1.5.5 / D035 / D067），由 E-Shop F3 以 embed-modal iframe 開啟——無全域導航／麵包屑／頁首（標題與關閉由 modal 外框提供），動作置底部提交列（.ss-actionbar）。IA：店面門面卡常駐置頂——用 Base44／Facebook 式身分帶（封面＋疊加 logo 頭像＋店名／網址／簡介為文字），逐欄就地編輯（.ss-edit：文字態 ↔ 內嵌 input/textarea/select，✓/Enter 確認、✕/Esc 取消）。品牌素材就是封面＋頭像（各自有編輯鈕），不另設上傳框——其下商品陳列／付款／出貨三個對等設定群組以 tab 切換（一次處理其一），另有 粉絲視角預覽（See as fan）畫面分割。整頁用滿標準 1280px 的 .page 欄寬（非兩欄詳情頁，不套 .page--narrow）。本元件補基礎控制項沒有的欄位型別——網址前綴（.ss-url）、金額前綴（.amount-field）、唯讀 Stripe 卡（.ss-status）——拖曳排序清單（.ss-order，粉絲端順序 · F3 / D031）與粉絲預覽內容（.ss-fan）。

4.56 Preview panel

🟠 organism

Right-hand split panel holding the live preview card — not an overlay. 右側畫面分割面板，承載即時預覽卡——非浮層遮蓋。由建立流程頂部 Preview 鈕按需開啟：佔版面、把 wizard 壓窄（body.preview-open），表單仍可見可編輯，無變暗遮罩。✕／Esc 關閉復位。此處靜態展示。

Reused by E-Shop F5 “Store preview”: .preview-panel--inset compresses .main instead of the wizard. There it is toggleable, default-closed (opened from the F3 “Store preview” button; closed via a floating ✕ in the sheet’s top-right + Esc — spec F5 / D084) and runs headerless (no .preview-panel__head; the “商店預覽” label lives in the fan-store hero overline). On narrow screens (≤1100px) it falls back to a static block stacked below the list.

由 E-Shop F5「商店預覽」重用：.preview-panel--inset 壓窄的是 .main 而非 wizard。在該頁為可開關、預設關閉（由 F3「商店預覽」鈕開啟；關閉走 sheet 右上浮動 ✕＋Esc——spec F5／D084），且為 headerless（無 .preview-panel__head，「商店預覽」標題移進 fan-store hero overline）。窄螢幕（≤1100px）退化為靜態區塊堆疊在清單下方。

4.57 Fan store preview

The fan-side storefront rendered inside every “See as fan” preview — shared by E-Shop F5 (Store preview) and Store settings F1. Per spec §6.7 the preview is the fan end (same source, difference = defect), so both pages inject one shared markup (partials/fan-store.js). 2026-07-02: presented as a mobile phone — a dark device shell (.fan-store__phone) whose self-scrolling screen (.fan-store__screen) is the fan-app store page: app bar (menu · ztor. · cart/user) + hero (artist name over a dark gradient cover + socials + Join community) + sticky app-section pills (Shop/Events/Ranks/Posts/About) + featured + Products/Bundles/Auctions underline sub-tabs + 2-col product grid with cart buttons + Top fans + About + sticky bottom app nav. Layout direction from the endgame creator-store mobile prototype (visual evidence only).

4.58 Dropdown menu

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

Native <details>/<summary> action menu: any .btn as trigger, a floating panel of action links below-right. No JS — open/close is the native details toggle. Use for "create / more actions" menus in toolbars; avoid for nav mega-dropdowns (use NavigationMenu) and for form value selection (use a select/Input).

原生 <details>/<summary> 動作選單：任一 .btn 當觸發器，下方靠右浮出動作連結面板。不需 JS — 開合走原生 details。用於工具列的「建立／更多動作」選單；導覽 mega-dropdown 別用（改用 NavigationMenu），表單選值也別用（改用 select／Input）。

Relationships

元件關係

Built from由哪些元件組成 ↓
atomButton

Rendered preview (open state pinned for display)

視覺展示 (展示用固定展開)

＋ New ▾
Create new product Create bundle from products Create auction
Edit
Minimum tier that can buy買得到的最低分級

The third menu is the --ladder variant (E-Shop's Fan-tier threshold, 2026-07-31). Clicking a tier sets the threshold there: that tier and every tier above it become checked, so the checked set is always a run from the top — the left rail draws that run. The third row is pinned in the --preview state to show the hover forecast ("click here and this row joins too"). The trailing .dropdown__meta numbers are cumulative — "how many fans can buy if the threshold sits on this row" — so they read straight down as the cost of tightening the gate.

第三個選單是 --ladder 變體（電子商店的粉絲分級門檻，2026-07-31）。點某一級＝把門檻設在那一級，該級與其上各級一起成為已選態，所以已選的永遠是從頂端連續的一段——左緣那條線畫的就是那一段。第三列刻意固定在 --preview 狀態，示範 hover 預告（「點這裡的話這一列也會被納入」）。 尾端 .dropdown__meta 的數字是累計值——「門檻設在這一列，有多少人買得到」——所以往下讀就是把門檻收緊的代價。

Triggers: any .btn (primary ＋ New or a btn--icon kebab for per-row actions). Items can be <a> (navigate) or <button> (run JS — reset to look like a link); state-dependent items toggle with [hidden] (e.g. E-Shop row publish/unpublish). E-Shop product rows use the kebab variant; native <details> needs page JS for outside-click / select-to-close.

觸發器：任何 .btn（主要 ＋ New，或列操作用 btn--icon kebab）。選單項可用 <a>（導頁）或 <button>（跑 JS，已重置成連結外觀）；隨狀態切換的選單項用 [hidden] 互斥顯示（如電子商店列的上架/下架）。電子商店商品列用 kebab 變體；原生 <details> 的「點外部／選後收起」需頁面 JS 補。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Use a real .btn variant as the summary trigger.
  • 用真正的 .btn 變體當 summary 觸發器。
  • Keep items short, action-first, max ~6 entries.
  • 項目精短、動詞開頭，最多約 6 條。
  • Lead every item with a matching .ztor-icon (2026-07-21 使用者裁示) — the only exception is .dropdown__item--toggle (a switch row, e.g. E-Shop's List-in-shop toggle).
  • 每個選項前面都要有對應的 .ztor-icon（2026-07-21 使用者裁示）——唯一例外是 .dropdown__item--toggle（開關列，如電子商店的「在商店上架」）。
Don't別做
  • Don't rebuild it per page with inline styles — link dropdown-menu.css.
  • 別在頁內用 inline style 重刻 — 連結 dropdown-menu.css。
  • Don't use it for navigation menus or form selects.
  • 別拿來做導覽選單或表單下拉選值。

Same icon-exemption as --toggle: the leading slot holds the tier .badge (same badge vocabulary as tier-settings, no second palette). Selected state is the trailing .dropdown__check, never a background tint — a tinted row fights :hover and the user can't tell "I picked this" from "my mouse is here".值列（menuitemcheckbox），2026-07-29——不是動作，是一個值。與 --toggle 同樣豁免領頭 icon 規則：領頭位置放該分級的 .badge（與 tier-settings 同一套徽章語彙，不另立第二套配色）。已選態靠尾端的 .dropdown__check，不用底色——底色會跟 :hover 打架，使用者分不清「這是我選的」還是「我的滑鼠在這」。
.dropdown__menu--ladderRenders a group of --choice rows as one ladder (2026-07-31, E-Shop Fan tier). Adds a 2px --selected-ink rail down the left edge of every checked row, so the contiguous run reads as one range instead of four independent switches. Interaction (click sets the threshold) is page JS — the CSS only draws the run.把一組 --choice 值列呈現成「一道階梯」（2026-07-31，電子商店粉絲分級）。已選列左緣加一條 2px --selected-ink 直線，讓連續的一段讀起來是一個範圍，而不是四個獨立開關。互動（點一級＝設門檻）由頁面 JS 負責，CSS 只負責畫出那一段。
.dropdown__item--previewHover forecast inside --ladder: rows that would become checked show a 40%-opacity check. Makes the ladder relationship visible before the click, so nobody has to click wrong once to learn it.--ladder 內的 hover 預告：點下去會被納入的列先顯示 40% 透明度的 check。讓階梯關係在點擊前就看得見，不必先點錯一次才學會。
.dropdown__metaTrailing secondary value on a value row (E-Shop tier menu: "988 fans" = how many fans can buy if the threshold sits here). margin-left:auto pushes it right so the four numbers line up as a column you can compare down; tabular-nums keeps the digits from shifting. Muted color and one step smaller — it is a number that helps you decide, not the thing the row selects.值列尾端的次要資訊（電子商店分級選單的「988 人」＝門檻設在這一級有多少人買得到）。margin-left:auto 推到右側，四列數字對成一欄可以直接往下比；tabular-nums 讓位數不跳動。次要色、小一階字——它是幫忙做決定的參考值，不是這一列選的東西本身。
.dropdown__capMenu caption — one small uppercase line naming the question the value rows answer (e.g. "Minimum tier that can buy"). Not an item, not clickable, so it is not a .dropdown__item.選單抬頭——一行小字說明這組值列在回答什麼問題（如「買得到的最低分級」）。不是選項、不可點，所以不是 .dropdown__item。

4.60 View switch ✝ retired

⚰️ tombstone

Retired 2026-07-23. A pill-shaped two-icon toggle (solid foreground fill on the active side) that flipped Projects between list and card view. User feedback: it read as ugly and off-system — the solid fill was a third way of drawing "selected" on this site, fighting Segmented control's white-raised pill. Its role — switching the view of the same data — is what Segmented control already owns, so it was folded into that component's icon-only variant .segmented__btn--icon rather than kept as a second pattern. Rules removed from shared.css (tombstone comment left in place).

2026-07-23 退場。膠囊形雙圖示切換器（選中側實心填 foreground），原本用於 Projects 的清單／卡片切換。使用者反饋很醜、和 design system 不搭——實心填是站上第三種「已選中」畫法，與 Segmented control 的白浮起 pill 打架。它的角色（同一資料的視角切換）本來就屬於 Segmented control，因此收斂成該元件的純圖示變體 .segmented__btn--icon，不另留第二套。規則已自 shared.css 移除（原處留墓碑註解）。

4.62 Restock table

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

Restock popup for the E-Shop restock sub-flow (spec §5.1.5.6, D104 order model + D106 member tabs). A restock is one order: the popup reuses the canonical payout dialog shell (.payout-modal / .payout-dialog) with a document layer — method as .segmented.radio-cards (two side-by-side cards + top-right orange dot, Restock now / Scheduled) plus supplier / notes and, for Scheduled, an expected-arrival date — and an item layer that is a .restock-table of three number columns per row: Current (read-only), Restock (typeable), After (read-only, live current + restock). 2026-07-22 layout (Figma node 861-28842): the item table sits right below the method (product-name label then table); supplier / notes / ETA move below the table; the footer (Cancel / Submit) is pinned to the dialog bottom — only the body scrolls (same pattern as the platform-fee modal); the old under-method hint row and the yellow stickynote have been removed. A product's variants are a matrix of rows (single-variant = 1 row; 2-option = sub-grouped by option-1 via .restock-table__group) — no tabs. A bundle separates its member products with .tabs (one tab per member); each tab panel (.tab-panel) holds that member's variant table. Only one tab level (members) — variants never use tabs; quantities persist across tabs. History log on product-detail reuses .data-list. Mounted from partials/restock-modal.js.

E-Shop 補貨子流程 popup（spec §5.1.5.6，D104 補貨單＋D106 成員 tab）。一次補貨＝一張補貨單：popup 重用 canonical payout dialog 外殼（.payout-modal／.payout-dialog），單據層＝補貨方式改用 .segmented.radio-cards（兩張並排卡＋右上橘點，立即／定時）＋供應商／備註，定時另加預計到貨時間，整張填一次；品項層＝.restock-table 三欄數字表，每列：當前數量（唯讀）、補貨數量（可填）、補後數量（唯讀，即時＝當前＋補貨）。2026-07-22 版型（Figma node 861-28842）：逐選項表移到方式正下方（先商品名稱標題再表格）；供應商／備註／預計到貨改到表格下方；footer（取消／送出補貨）釘在框底、只捲 body（與平台費率彈窗同一套）；方式下方的灰色提示行與底部黃色 stickynote 已移除。商品的規格是矩陣列（單一選項＝1 列；2 選項以選項一分組 .restock-table__group）——不用 tab。組合則以 .tabs 把成員商品分開（一成員一 tab），每個 tab 面板（.tab-panel）放該成員的規格表。只有一層 tab（成員），規格不用 tab；數量跨 tab 保留。商品細節頁補貨紀錄重用 .data-list。由 partials/restock-modal.js 掛載。

Three number columns per row: Current and After are read-only (.restock-table__ro, muted, not typeable); only Restock takes input, and After recomputes live as current + restock.

每列三欄數字：當前與補後唯讀（.restock-table__ro，靜音底、不可打字），只有補貨可填，補後隨補貨即時算成「當前＋補貨」。

Rows group by option-1 via .restock-table__group (Small / Medium). A bundle shows one member tab per product, each tab its own table; a single-variant product is one table with a single row and no group header.

每列依選項一以 .restock-table__group 分組（Small／Medium）。組合以成員 tab 分開每個商品、各自一張表；單一選項商品則是一張只有一列、無分組標題的表。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Keep the 2026-07-22 order: method (radio-cards) → product-name label → .restock-table → supplier / notes / ETA below; pin the footer to the dialog bottom, scroll only the body.
  • 照 2026-07-22 順序：方式（radio-cards）→ 商品名稱標題 → .restock-table → 供應商／備註／到貨在下方；footer 釘框底、只捲 body。
  • Keep Current and After read-only (.restock-table__ro); only Restock is typeable — stock rises only through a logged restock.
  • 當前與補後維持唯讀（.restock-table__ro），只有補貨可填——庫存只透過有紀錄的補貨上升。
  • Group a multi-variant product or bundle member with .restock-table__group; bundle members = .tabs (one tab per member product, D106).
  • 多選項商品或組合成員以 .restock-table__group 分組；組合成員＝.tabs（一成員一 tab，D106）。
Don't別做
  • Don't fork the dialog / form / segmented / tabs / data-list styles — only the .restock-table rows are restock-specific.
  • 別 fork dialog／表單／segmented／tabs／data-list 樣式 — 只有 .restock-table 列是 restock 專屬。
  • Don't put method / supplier / ETA on each row, and don't bring back the under-method hint row or the yellow stickynote — the 2026-07-22 layout removed them.
  • 別把方式／供應商／到貨放進每列，也別找回方式下的提示行或黃色 stickynote——2026-07-22 版型已移除。
  • Don't tab variants or nest tabs — only member products get tabs; variants stay a table (avoids two-level tabs).
  • 別把規格做成 tab、別巢狀 tab — 只有成員商品用 tab，規格維持表格（避免兩層 tab）。

4.66 Composer

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

Drop-or-type input card with a bottom action bar: left tool icons, right credit meter and a circular send button that flips to orange when there's content. Use when a creator submits a prompt or uploads an asset and you need a single card combining input, tool affordances, credit meter, and submit. Avoid for plain single-line fields.

可拖放或輸入的輸入卡，底部有動作列：左側工具圖示、右側 credit 計量與一個圓形送出按鈕，有內容時翻成橘色。當創作者要送出 prompt 或上傳素材，而你需要一張卡片同時整合輸入、工具提示、credit 計量與送出時使用。純單行欄位別用。

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

Inline notice with a status-tinted icon, title, description, optional CTA, and (card density) a chevron close button. Use .alert--card in the dashboard alerts panel; .alert--row for inline page warnings (low-stock, region). Avoid for a single editorial hint — use the Info banner.

Page-top variant (.alert-inset ＋ .alert--inset-card — the shell below stands in for .main; sticky positioning omitted in this demo). When it is sticky (2026-08-01), ::before lays a --surface-page scrim behind the card — 200px above so nothing peeks through the 16px gap, and --alert-inset-fade (44px) below so content fades out under the notice instead of being cut by a hard edge. z-index is 10, above ordinary content and .list-toolbar (6), below a stuck .list-dock (20), popovers (30) and the topbar (50). When a page wants a stuck toolbar, use the shared snap dock (.list-dock + js/sticky-dock.js) rather than hand-rolling it — while it is snapped, .main:has(.list-dock.is-snapped) .alert-inset drops the sticky so the notice scrolls away.

頁面貼頂變體 (.alert-inset ＋ .alert--inset-card — 下方外框代表 .main；demo 中不套 sticky）。真的黏頂時（2026-08-01）由 ::before 墊一層 --surface-page 同色底：上緣多蓋 200px，讓上方那道 16px 空隙不漏內容；下緣延伸 --alert-inset-fade（44px）做漸層，內容在通知下方漸消而不是被硬邊切斷。z-index 為 10——高過一般內容與 .list-toolbar（6），低於黏頂的 .list-dock（20）、浮層（30）與 topbar（50）。頁面若讓工作列貼頂，一律走共用的 snap dock（.list-dock ＋ js/sticky-dock.js），不要手刻——貼頂時 .main:has(.list-dock.is-snapped) .alert-inset 會解除 sticky，通知條隨頁面捲走。

4.70 Status axes

🟡 molecule

Two independent order status tracks shown together (spec 5.1.5.3.1 §2.2 / PCR-001): fulfilment (履約: To ship / Awaiting pickup / Shipped / Completed) and payment·settlement (收入結算: Paid / Refunded / Disputed). The two axes are never combined into a single badge. .status-axes = badges side by side (list rows, fulfilment first); .status-axes--split gives each axis its own group, divided by a hairline rule (order detail header). 2026-08-07: the older .status-axes--labeled variant (an uppercase label above each axis) was retired — the rule already delivers what PCR-001 asks for, and the badge wording (Shipped / Awaiting pickup vs Paid) already says which axis it belongs to, so the labels said the same thing twice. Badges come from badge.css — Paid uses badge--success (green, Q11 2026-07-13; was badge--neutral).

訂單兩條獨立狀態軸並列（規格 5.1.5.3.1 §2.2 / PCR-001）：履約（待出貨／待取貨／已出貨／已完成）與收入結算（Paid／Refunded／Disputed），不併成單一 badge。.status-axes＝badge 並排（清單列，履約在前）；.status-axes--split 每軸自成一組、中間以細分隔線區隔（訂單詳情頁首）。2026-08-07：原本每軸上方掛大寫標籤的 .status-axes--labeled 變體退場——分隔線已經達成 PCR-001 要的「兩軸不混成一顆徽章」，而徽章文字（已出貨／待取貨 vs 已付款）本身就說明它屬於哪一軸，標籤是把同一件事講兩次。badge 取自 badge.css——Paid 用 badge--success（綠色，Q11 2026-07-13；原為 badge--neutral）。

4.71 Chart

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

SVG-based visualization family with five sub-patterns (line chart, bar chart, stacked bar, source-list legend, rank bars) plus a .chart-card composition shell and a JS-driven tooltip/cursor layer. Use .linechart for trends, .barchart for discrete values, .stacked-bar + .source-list for a proportion breakdown, .rank-bars for ranked rows, and .chart-card to wrap with head + footer; avoid for exact tabular figures — use .ztor-table.

以 SVG 為基礎的視覺化家族，含五種 sub-pattern（line chart、bar chart、stacked bar、source-list legend、rank bars），外加一個 .chart-card 組合外殼與 JS 驅動的 tooltip／cursor 層。趨勢用 .linechart，離散值用 .barchart，比例拆解用 .stacked-bar + .source-list，排名列用 .rank-bars，要包 head + footer 用 .chart-card；要精確的表格數字別用 — 改用 .ztor-table。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Give .pie aria-hidden="true" — the legend beside it carries every number.
  • 給 .pie 加 aria-hidden="true"——數字全在旁邊的圖例上。
  • Write --pie-stops segment bounds as cumulative percentages, each starting at 0.
  • --pie-stops 的段界寫累計百分比，每段起點一律寫 0。
  • Set stacked-bar segment widths + palette inline.
  • stacked-bar 的 segment 寬度 + 配色用 inline 設定。
  • Scale .rank-bar__fill so the largest value reads 100%.
  • 縮放 .rank-bar__fill，讓最大值讀作 100%。
  • Override --donut-hole when the donut sits on a surface other than --card.
  • 圓環放在非 --card 底色上時，一併覆寫 --donut-hole。
Don't別做
  • Apply .linechart__area to multi-series charts.
  • 把 .linechart__area 套到多 series 的圖上。
  • Rely on hover tooltip/cursor for essential values (JS-driven, pointer-only).
  • 關鍵數值靠 hover 的 tooltip／cursor（JS 驅動、僅限 pointer）。
  • Force 3+ segments into .donut — use .pie, .stacked-bar or .rank-bar instead.
  • 把三段以上的比例硬塞進 .donut——改用 .pie、.stacked-bar 或 .rank-bar。
  • Reach for .pie to rank things — a pie answers "how was this whole split", a bar answers "which is bigger".
  • 用 .pie 比大小——圓餅回答「這一整塊是怎麼被分掉的」，長條才回答「誰比誰長」。

4.72 Earnings waterfall

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

A statement-style vertical ledger (spec §5.1.8 F12) that walks gross revenue down to distributable profit and its Creator / NFT split. Reads like a P&L — milestones (income / subtotal / pool / distribution) carry a running-balance bar; deductions are plain indented name … −amount rows with no bar, so it doesn't become a wall of bars. Figures follow §7.3 (only settled income counts). Used on the Earnings · Breakdown tab and reused for the F11 per-project ladder and the F7 transaction mini-ladder.

報表式垂直帳本（spec §5.1.8 F12），把總收入一路走到可分配淨利與 Creator／NFT 分配。讀起來像損益表——里程碑（income／subtotal／pool／distribution）帶 running-balance 條；扣項是純文字縮排 名稱 … −金額 列、不帶條，避免變成一面 bar 牆。數字口徑依 §7.3（僅計已結算收入）。用於 Earnings · Breakdown 分頁，並重用於 F11 單一項目階梯與 F7 交易小階梯。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Set each __fill width to the running balance as a % of gross — the descending staircase is the point.
  • 把每條 __fill 寬度設為「該階後的 running balance ÷ 總收入」%——下降的階梯就是重點。
  • Mark milestones with --subtotal / --pool and allocations with --distribution.
  • 里程碑用 --subtotal／--pool，分配列用 --distribution 標示。
Don't別做
  • Don't render $0 rows to fake a full waterfall — use .waterfall__empty when there is no settled income.
  • 別用 $0 列假裝完整瀑布——沒有已結算收入時改用 .waterfall__empty。
  • Don't put unsettled / disputed amounts into distributable profit.
  • 別把未結算／爭議中金額算進可分配淨利。

4.77 Leave dialog

🟠 organism

Confirm-before-leaving dialog for every create / edit flow. Injected and driven by partials/wizard-chrome.js, shared by all 6 create pages. Two states, one shell: when the page has unsaved edits it asks about saving (Save and leave / Leave without saving); when nothing was edited it just confirms leaving (Leave) — no save question. Pages with no save affordance in the top bar can opt out of the save question entirely via .wizard[data-leave-simple] and always show the plain-leave state. Capped card, dimmed scrim, title + body + stacked actions + corner close.

建立／編輯流程的「返回離開確認」彈窗。由 partials/wizard-chrome.js 注入並控制，6 個建立頁共用。兩個型態、同一外殼：頁面有未存編輯時問儲存（儲存並離開／不儲存就離開）；沒編輯過則只確認離開（離開）、不問儲存。頂列沒有儲存入口的頁面可加 .wizard[data-leave-simple] 完全跳過問儲存那一態，一律走純離開版。有上限的卡、變暗 scrim、標題＋內文＋堆疊操作＋右上關閉。

要先儲存再離開嗎？

這一頁有你做的編輯。

要離開這一頁嗎？

你隨時可以再回來。

Esc / scrim / × cancel.

4.79 Album tracks

🟠 organism

Multi-track manager for digital products whose sub-category is Album (spec 5.1.5.2 §4.2 F11.1). Empty state shows a "No files uploaded yet" placeholder. Upload multiple audio (mp3) / video (mp4) files; each becomes a track row with a cover, editable name, file meta (name · size · time), drag-to-reorder handle, and a ⋮ menu (Edit name · Change image · Upload lyrics · Delete). Hovering the cover reveals play/pause + edit (change image). Uploading rows show "…is uploading…" with an indeterminate bar and no drag handle. Note: presentation-layer demo — upload / lyrics / cover are faked (files shown via object URL, no real upload or storage). Track-field product details (min 1 track, cover required, lyrics format, size limits, preview) are TBC upstream (recorded in ASSUMPTIONS).

E-Shop sibling of Orders. 2026-08-01: the session-detail first screen now borrows the product-detail skeleton wholesale — .form-section--outlined card, .form-grid two columns, .form-section__head/__title headings, .bento + .kpi--compact for the big number, .kv for the summary. .pickup-board only adds the column divider and the responsive stack; left column is what is being collected, right column is what staff need to scan (.scanner-hand URL + password). The roster moved to .pickup-roster on .ztor-table, one column per spec field. The full Scanner access settings card and .pickup-select rows are kept below for the standalone scanner page and the create-session popup (F3).

4.83 Mobile scanner

🟠 organism

Standalone phone scanner (spec 5.1.5.14 F1 · D111/D121) — a separate URL with no Studio nav. Staff enter the session password, then scan buyer QR codes to redeem. Camera viewport uses the --surface-inverse role token (not a raw dark hex). Screens: password gate → scan → result → confirm. After unlock, a Scan/Items/Roster sub-nav also exposes F2 verifiable items (canonical definition) and F3 a read-only check-in roster for manual lookup when a QR can't be scanned — neither links out to other Studio pages, matching the scanner's permission boundary.

獨立手機 scanner（規格 5.1.5.14 F1 · D111/D121）——獨立 URL、無主工作台導航。工作人員輸入場次密碼後掃買家 QR 核銷。相機視窗用 --surface-inverse role token（非裸色深色）。畫面：密碼→掃描→結果→確認。解鎖後多一列 Scan／Items／Roster 分頁，分別是 F2 可核銷項目（正式定義）與 F3 唯讀取貨/入場名單（QR 無法掃描時人工查詢核對）——皆不連出其他工作台頁面，對齊 scanner 的權限邊界。

4.84 Radio list

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

Lightweight vertical 1-of-N picker: a radio dot + title (optional one-line sub) per row; a filled orange dot marks the selection. Lighter than Selection card (no card frame/shadow) and, unlike Segmented, it is a data choice rather than a view switch. Two variants: base keeps every option visible; --collapsible (2026-07-21, Figma 856-22782) shows only the current selection plus a chevron and reveals the full list on click — use it when the picker sits in a narrow column and vertical space is scarce, e.g. Listing settings (Don't list / List now / Schedule) under the store-preview card. In the collapsible variant the selected option appears twice while open (once in the trigger, once in the list) — that is the intended Figma behaviour. Independent component (own classes + JS), not built on Segmented. New consumption context (2026-08-09): the base variant now also covers single-select options inside a form — create-event's ticket-tier rules block (purchase condition / per-person limit / discount) uses .radio-list for its radio choice, replacing a short-lived page-local drawn-radio (see the retired .zradio).

輕量垂直單選：每列一個 radio 圓點＋標題（可帶一句描述），圓點填橘＝選中。比 Selection card 輕（無卡框陰影）；與 Segmented 的分工是它做資料選擇、不是視角切換。兩個變體：base 選項恆展開；--collapsible（2026-07-21，Figma 856-22782）收起時只顯示目前選項＋chevron，點一下才展開完整清單，用於窄欄、垂直空間吃緊的情境——例如商店預覽卡下的上架設定（不上架／立刻上架／定時上架）。收合式展開時已選項會出現兩次（觸發列一次、清單一次），這是 Figma 原設計、刻意保留。獨立元件（自有 class＋JS），非建在 Segmented 上。新消費情境（2026-08-09）：base 變體現在也承接表單裡的規則選項——建立活動的票種卡購票規則區塊（購票條件／每人限購／折扣）改用 .radio-list 做單選，取代短命存在過的頁內自繪 radio（見已退場的 .zradio）。

Rendered preview

視覺展示

Base — every option visibleBase — 選項恆展開

--collapsible — click the trigger to open--collapsible — 點觸發列展開

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Use for mutually-exclusive data choices; pick --collapsible when vertical space is scarce.
  • 用於互斥的資料選擇；垂直空間吃緊時選 --collapsible。
  • Sit it on a white / --card surface (hover uses --accent).
  • 放在白／--card 底上（hover 用 --accent）。
Don't別做
  • Use it to switch the view of one dataset — that's Segmented.
  • 別用在切換同一資料的視角（那是 Segmented）。
  • Mix both variants for the same role on different pages — Listing settings is collapsible everywhere.
  • 別讓同一角色在不同頁用不同變體——上架設定全站一律收合式。

Specification

規格

Sourceradio-list.css · partials/radio-list.js (collapsible behaviour)
AnatomyBase: .radio-list > .radio-list__item (--active) > .radio-list__dot + .radio-list__text (__title + optional __sub).
Collapsible: .radio-list.radio-list--collapsible[data-open] > .radio-list__trigger (dot + text + .radio-list__chevron) + .radio-list__options[hidden] > .radio-list__item.
Variants(base) every option visible · --collapsible trigger + disclosure list, 1px --border frame at --radius-xl, open trigger fills --input-surface, chevron rotates 180°.
Statesdefault · hover (--accent) · focus-visible (--ring) · selected (--active, orange filled dot) · open / closed ([data-open], collapsible only).
Behavior / usageVertical flex; transparent rows, hover --accent; selected = orange filled dot (--primary), no bg/border change. Rows with no .radio-list__sub vertically center dot + title. partials/radio-list.js auto-mounts every .radio-list--collapsible: toggles open state, mirrors the selected row's text + data-i18n keys into the trigger, closes on outside click / Esc, and dispatches radio-list:change (detail.item) so pages only own their own field-reveal logic.
Token usage--foreground, --accent, --muted-foreground, --primary, --border, --input-surface, --ring, --radius-md, --radius-xl, --sp-2/8/10, --fs-14/12, --duration, --easing.

4.85 Date input placeholder

🔵 atom

Purpose

用途

Native <input type="date|datetime-local|time"> ignores placeholder and paints its own 年/月/日 --:-- mask in ordinary body colour, so an untouched field reads as already filled. This decorator replaces the empty state with the same placeholder language every other field uses: calendar icon + muted "Pick a date". Filled state is untouched — the date renders in normal body colour at the field's original padding, so no layout shifts. Applied automatically site-wide by partials/date-input.js; pages keep plain <input class="input" type="date"> markup.

原生 <input type="date|datetime-local|time"> 不吃 placeholder，空值時瀏覽器自己畫「年/月/日 --:--」且用一般內文色，看起來像已經填了值。本裝飾層把空值狀態換成站上其他欄位一致的 placeholder 語言：日曆 icon ＋ 淡灰「選擇日期」。已填狀態完全不動——日期用正常內文色、內距回到欄位原值，不造成任何位移。由 partials/date-input.js 全站自動套用，頁面 markup 維持乾淨的 <input class="input" type="date">。

Rendered preview

視覺展示

Empty — icon + placeholder空值 — icon ＋ placeholder

Filled — plain body colour, original padding已填 — 正常內文色、原始內距

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Leave page markup as a bare .input — the decorator wraps it at runtime.
  • 頁面 markup 就寫乾淨的 .input，包裝交給執行期的裝飾層。
  • Call ZtorDateInput.mount(scope) only if you bypass the DOM observer.
  • 只有繞過 DOM observer 時才需要自己呼叫 ZtorDateInput.mount(scope)。
Don't別做
  • Hand-write .date-input wrappers in pages — duplicated markup drifts.
  • 別在頁面手寫 .date-input 外層，重複 markup 會分岔。
  • Keep the icon visible when filled — it eats 28px and clips narrow fields.
  • 別讓 icon 在已填狀態留著——它吃掉 28px，窄欄會被切字。

Specification

規格

Sourcedate-input.css · partials/date-input.js
Anatomy.date-input[data-empty] > .date-input__icon + .input + .date-input__ph. The wrapper, icon and placeholder are injected at runtime; pages only author the .input.
States[data-empty="true"] calendar icon at --sp-12 + "Pick a date" at --sp-40 in --muted-foreground, native ::-webkit-datetime-edit hidden, input padded to --sp-40 · [data-empty="false"] icon and placeholder hidden, padding back to the base --sp-12, date in --foreground.
Behavior / usageCovers date, datetime-local and time — all three share the "Pick a date" copy (field.pick-date) per the 2026-07-21 ruling. The native calendar button is flattened into a transparent full-field overlay, so clicking anywhere opens the picker via showPicker(). A MutationObserver catches runtime-injected fields (restock, pickup session, manual entry, product post modals) so partials need no wiring of their own.
Token usage--muted-foreground, --foreground, --font-body, --fs-14, --sp-12, --sp-40.
Classes.date-input · .date-input__icon · .date-input__ph
DependenciesDecorates Input; composes Icon (calendar).
Evidence / usage~40 date fields across 17 pages: create-product · create-bundle · create-auction · create-event · create-campaign · create-project · product-detail · bundle-detail · settings · fans-crm · admin-platform-fees · ip-bank-reporting · pickup · pickup-detail · e-shop · earnings, plus the restock / pickup-session / manual-entry / product-post modals.

4.87 Stock readout

🔵 atom

Purpose

用途

A read-only quantity shown as a big number rather than an input, for values that can only change through a specific action. Product detail uses it for stock: units are added by Restock (every restock is logged), so rendering it as an .input would imply you can type over it. The optional denominator (a Limited edition cap) and the unit both live in __unit, keeping the number itself the single focal point.

唯讀的數量，用大數字而非輸入框呈現——適用於「只能透過某個特定動作改變」的值。商品明細的庫存用它：庫存只能靠補貨增加（每筆留紀錄），做成 .input 會讓人以為可以打字覆蓋。可選的分母（限量版本的上限）與單位都收在 __unit 裡，讓數值本身維持單一焦點。

Rendered preview

視覺展示

3 units Low Stock
To add units, use Restock on the right — every restock is logged.
18 / 50 units
Limited edition — the cap goes in the unit slot, no badge needed.

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Pair it with a hint naming the action that changes the number.
  • 配一句 hint 說明「要改這個數字得做什麼」。
  • Put the cap and unit together in __unit.
  • 分母與單位一起放進 __unit。
Don't別做
  • Don't use KPI here — that's a standalone metric tile for dashboards; this is a line inside a form card.
  • 別拿 KPI 來用——那是儀表列用的獨立方塊，這個是表單卡內的一行讀數。
  • Don't render an editable .input for a value the user can't actually type into.
  • 使用者其實不能打字的值，別做成可編輯的 .input。

Specification

Anatomy.stock-readout > .stock-readout__num + .stock-readout__unit + optional Badge. Baseline-aligned flex row; no container styling of its own (it sits inside a .field).
Behavior / usageRead-only. The consumer decides whether to show a status badge (low stock / sold out) and swaps the denominator in when the edition is Limited. Product detail hides the / 50 span unless [data-when-edition="limited"].
Token usage--font-display, --fs-28, --fw-medium, --foreground（數值）; --fs-13, --muted-foreground（單位）; --sp-8, --sp-6. Letter-spacing −0.6px 為顯示字體的視覺補償，非 token。

4.88 Restock log

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

A restock history table: one row per restock, each field in its own aligned column. Restock records exist to be compared — how many more units than last time, how long since the previous restock — and columns are what make that scannable. It replaces the earlier Data list treatment that packed quantity, date and supplier into a title line plus a meta line, which could only be read one entry at a time. The --with-option modifier opens the option-combination column for multi-option products; without it that column disappears entirely, header included.

補貨紀錄表：每一筆補貨佔一列，每個欄位各自成欄地對齊。補貨紀錄是拿來比對的——這批比上批多幾件、上次補貨隔了多久——欄位對齊才掃得動。它取代原本用 Data list 把數量、日期、供應商擠成一行標題＋一行 meta 的寫法，那種寫法只能一筆一筆讀。多選項商品掛 --with-option 開出「選項組合」欄；不掛時該欄連同表頭整欄不顯示。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Put quantities in .restock-log__qty so tabular numerals line the digits up across rows.
  • 補貨數量放進 .restock-log__qty，等寬數字才會讓上下列的位數對齊。
  • Let .restock-log-wrap scroll horizontally on narrow viewports — columns stay aligned instead of reflowing.
  • 窄視窗讓 .restock-log-wrap 水平捲動——欄位維持對齊，不重排。
Don't別做
  • Don't hide the option cell row by row — the header and every row share one grid-template-columns, so removing a cell in only one place misaligns the table. Toggle --with-option on the container instead.
  • 別逐列隱藏選項儲存格——表頭與每一列共用同一組 grid-template-columns，只在其中一處拿掉會讓欄位錯位。改為在容器上切換 --with-option。
  • Don't put editable controls in a row — this is read-only history. For an editable priced spec table use the Variant builder.
  • 別把可編輯控件放進列裡——本元件是唯讀歷史。要可編輯的逐規格價格表請用 Variant builder。

Behavior / usageRead-only history, newest first. The wrapper owns the border, --radius-xl corners and horizontal scrolling; .restock-log holds a min-width: 480px floor so columns keep their alignment instead of collapsing. 4.89 Stock tip

🟢 atom

Purpose

用途

Hover or focus any product row's "Status" or "Stock" cell in the E-Shop product list → a small floating info card. For multi-option or bundle rows, it lists every option combination's own stock count (bundle members flattened down to their own option combinations too). Promoted 2026-07-23 from user feedback — wanting the per-option breakdown visible without opening the Restock popup. Scope was widened the same day: asked why single-variant rows (zine, acetate, pin) didn't get it too — for those rows the card restates current stock (with its real health colour). It briefly also showed a computed low-stock threshold line, added then removed the same day on user instruction — the threshold logic (lowThr(), 10% of cap) still lives in the shared data layer for the Restock popup, it just isn't surfaced in this card anymore.

hover 或 focus 電子商店商品清單裡任何一列的「狀態」或「庫存」欄 → 浮出一張小卡。多選項或組合商品列會列出每個選項組合各自的庫存（組合商品連成員都攤到成員自己的選項組合）。2026-07-23 依使用者反饋 promote——想在不開補貨彈窗的情況下就看到逐選項的庫存。同一天擴大範圍：使用者追問「為什麼單一選項商品（zine、acetate、pin）沒有」——這些列改顯示「目前庫存」一行（照實際健康度上色）。中間曾短暫多顯示一行低庫存門檻，同一天使用者又指示拿掉——門檻換算邏輯（lowThr()，cap 的 10%）仍留在共用資料層給補貨彈窗用，只是這張浮卡不再顯示。

Relationships

元件關係

Built from由哪些元件組成 ↓
No sub-components — plain floating card沒有子元件——單純的浮出卡
Used by被哪些元件使用 ↑
Sits directly on Product list's status/stock cells直接掛在 Product list 的狀態／庫存儲存格上

Why JS positions it, not pure CSS :hover

為什麼定位靠 JS、不是純 CSS :hover

The list scrolls under a sticky filter bar (E-Shop's .list-toolbar / .list-status-row). A row near the top of the viewport would have its popup covered by the sticky bar if it always opened upward; a row near the bottom would push the popup off-screen if it always opened downward. JS measures the trigger's getBoundingClientRect() on mouseenter/focusin, flips direction based on whether the row sits in the top or bottom half of the viewport, and sets position: fixed coordinates directly — plain CSS can't see viewport position to make that call.

清單捲動在一個有 sticky 篩選列的容器裡（電子商店的 .list-toolbar／.list-status-row）。固定往上開，viewport 上緣的列會被 sticky 列蓋到；固定往下開，viewport 下緣的列會把浮卡推出可視範圍。JS 在 mouseenter／focusin 量測觸發格的 getBoundingClientRect()，依列在 viewport 上半部或下半部翻轉開啟方向，直接設定 position: fixed 座標——純 CSS 看不到 viewport 位置，做不了這個判斷。

視覺展示 (靜態展示——demo 直接強制顯示開啟狀態；實際頁面靠 JS 在 hover/focus 時定位)

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Generate the popup content from the same variant data the Restock popup reads — never hand-type a second copy of the numbers.
  • 浮卡內容從補貨彈窗讀的同一份選項資料產生——別另外手key第二份數字。
  • Keep both cells' content identical for now (status cell and stock cell both show the full option breakdown).
  • 目前兩個欄位的內容維持一樣（狀態欄、庫存欄都顯示完整的選項明細）。
  • When the row's badge is "Low Stock" (e-shop.row.low), filter the list down to just the options that need restocking — omit the healthy ones entirely rather than just de-emphasizing them.
  • 列徽章是「急需補貨」（e-shop.row.low）時，清單只留需要補貨的選項——健康的選項直接不列，不是弱化顯示就好。
Don't別做
  • Don't leave a native title attribute on a cell that also carries .stock-tip — they compete on the same hover, stacking a browser-native tooltip on top of the custom popup (found on the acetate row's stock cell, removed 2026-07-23).
  • 別在掛了 .stock-tip 的儲存格上留原生 title 屬性——兩套 hover 提示會互搶，瀏覽器原生 tooltip 疊在自訂浮卡上面（acetate 列的庫存欄踩過，2026-07-23 移除）。
  • Don't put data-i18n directly on .stock-tip — i18n.js's innerHTML swap would wipe the .stock-tip__pop child. Wrap the translatable text in its own <span data-i18n> sibling instead.
  • 別把 data-i18n直接掛在 .stock-tip 上——i18n.js 的 innerHTML 覆寫會把子節點 .stock-tip__pop 一起清掉。可翻譯文字改包一層 <span data-i18n>手足。

Specification

規格

Sourcestock-tip.css
Anatomy.stock-tip (trigger cell, position: relative) > .stock-tip__pop (position: fixed card, role="tooltip") > .stock-tip__row (.stock-tip__name + .stock-tip__qty, --low/--out modifiers colour the quantity).
Statesdefault (closed) — opacity:0; visibility:hidden · .stock-tip.is-open (JS-added on mouseenter/focusin, removed on mouseleave/focusout) — popup fades in, position set inline by JS.
Behavior / usageContent is pre-populated once per row on page load into both the status cell's and the stock cell's .stock-tip__pop — only the position is recomputed on every hover. Rows with option data (from the same PRODUCT_MATRIX/PRODUCT_VARIANTS/BUNDLE_MEMBERS the Restock popup reads) get the per-option breakdown; if the row's status cell contains [data-i18n="e-shop.row.low"] ("Low Stock"), that list is filtered to just the low/out entries before rendering (2026-07-23). Rows without option data (single-variant) get one line instead (2026-07-23, scope widened): current stock, colour reflecting row[data-status] — the option-health filter above doesn't apply to it. A low-stock threshold line was briefly shown here too; removed same day on user instruction (the threshold math still lives in the shared data layer for the Restock popup).
Token usage--card (bg) · --shadow-float (E3, same rung as dropdown/readiness pops) · --radius-md · --foreground / --foreground-muted (label) · --status-warning / --status-error (quantity colour) · --fs-12 / --fw-medium / --lh-normal.
Classes.stock-tip · .stock-tip__pop · .stock-tip__row · .stock-tip__name · .stock-tip__qty(--low/--out)
DependenciesNone — plain CSS, no composed component.
Evidence / usagee-shop.html — every row of the Products tab (zine/tee/hoodie/acetate/pin) and both rows of the Bundles tab.

4.86 Nest

🔵 atom

Purpose

用途

A full-bleed block seated at the bottom of a card: its left, right and bottom edges meet the card's outer edge, and an upward-cast shadow lifts it off the card face. Use it when flipping a mode grows a whole set of controls below — e.g. switching Variations to "Multiple" in create-product. Aligned to Figma node 856:27798.

嵌在卡片底部的滿版子層：左右與下緣切齊卡片外緣，靠一道向上打的陰影跟卡面分開。用在「切換某個模式後，下方長出一整組設定」的情境——例如建立商品的商品選項切到「多選項」。對齊 Figma node 856:27798。

Rendered preview (toggle the theme — light separates by shadow alone, dark adds a translucent film)

視覺展示 （切換日／夜看差別——亮色只靠陰影分層，深色多疊一層半透明薄膜）

Variations

The nest below is flush with the card's own edges.

Two fills only — layer 3 and beyond use borders

只有兩層填色——第三層以後改用邊框

L1 card --card (absolute) → L2 nest --nest-surface (translucent film). Stacking a third fill makes every layer muddier and washes the canvas's colour temperature out, so depth beyond L2 is carried by a 1px border instead. The rule is not written into nest.css — a nest doesn't know what will be placed inside it, and a blanket .nest > * would hit the wrong things. Consumers apply it themselves; first case is Variant builder's .option-set__row / .variant-option, which dropped their --input-surface fill for transparent + 1px --border. L3 borders have no dedicated token — reuse --border.

L1 卡片 --card（絕對色）→ L2 nest --nest-surface（半透明薄膜）。再往上疊第三層填色會讓每一層都愈來愈糊、也把畫布的色溫洗掉，所以 L2 以後的層級改用 1px 邊框表達。這條規則不寫在 nest.css 裡——nest 不知道自己裡面會放什麼，硬寫 .nest > * 會誤傷；由消費端自己套。首個落地案例是 Variant builder 的 .option-set__row／.variant-option，它們把 --input-surface 填色換成 transparent ＋ 1px --border。L3 邊框沒有專屬 token，就用 --border。

Why a cool-grey film, not plain white: a white overlay neutralises the midnight canvas's cool cast (B−R drops from +2 to +0.8). The tint rgb(222,223,233) pushes it to +3.0 instead, staying the same temperature as the canvas. Same value Figma arrived at independently (856:27796).

為什麼用冷調薄膜、不用純白：純白疊上去會把 midnight 畫布的冷色調洗掉（B−R 由 +2 掉到 +0.8）。改用 rgb(222,223,233) 這個 tint 反而把冷調推到 +3.0，與畫布同溫。Figma 獨立算出的也是同一個值（856:27796）。

Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Put it last inside the card — it is anchored to the bottom edge.
  • 放在卡片的最後一個子元素——它是貼著底緣長的。
  • Use .card--muted instead for a static sub-block that keeps the card's inner padding.
  • 只是「卡片裡的一段」而且要保留卡片內距時，改用 .card--muted。
Don't別做
  • Don't put a dropdown or popover in a card that holds a nest — the card is clipped.
  • 含 nest 的卡片裡別放 dropdown／popover——那張卡被裁切，浮層會被切掉。
  • Don't stack a third fill inside a nest; use a border.
  • 別在 nest 裡再疊第三層填色，用邊框。

Specification

規格

Sourcenest.css
AnatomySingle block. Negative margins (calc(var(--sp-16) * -1)) cancel the parent card's --sp-16 padding on left / right / bottom; --sp-16 top margin keeps the gap from the preceding control.
Behavior / usageborder-radius matches the parent card's --radius-xl exactly, because the three edges are coincident. The parent is clipped via .form-section--outlined:has(> .nest) { overflow: hidden; } — required, because --shadow-nest-up has only a vertical offset and its 8px blur would otherwise spill sideways past the card's rounded corners onto the page. .nest[hidden] forces display:none so a consumer's own display:flex can't leak through.
Token usage--nest-surface（dark rgba(222,223,233,.04) / light transparent）, --shadow-nest-up（dark 0 -8px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.08) / light 0 -6px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.05)）, --radius-xl, --sp-16.
Classes.nest
DependenciesRequires a Form section .form-section--outlined parent. Distinct from Card .card--muted — see Do & Don't.
Evidence / usagecreate-product — Variations builder (#cp-var-builder), shown in Multiple-variations mode.

🟡 molecule

Purpose

Read-only tier comparison: the four tiers become columns, each row is one thing to compare (gates, headcount, each benefit). Do & Don't

該做與別做

Do該做
  • Keep all four tier columns equal width — that is what makes "fewer benefits going right" readable.

Don't別做
  • Put inputs or switches in it — read-only is the split between this and .bmx.
  • 別加輸入框或開關——唯讀是它與 .bmx 的分工。
  • Let a column size to its content; an unequal grid makes the comparison lie.
  • 別讓欄寬跟著內容跑，欄寬不齊比較就失真。

4.99 Fans guide page

🟠 organism

用途

「粉絲經營怎麼玩」整頁式說明頁（非操作手冊）——四個能力（排行、矩陣、階梯、流程）各自用自己真實的資料形狀呈現。四張長相一樣的卡片會對產品的實際樣子說謊，所以每一幕都取「它所解釋之物件」本來的形狀，捲動時逐一登場。

視覺展示 (靜態擷取一幕；捲動進場動效見 fans-guide.html 頁內 inline script)

先知道誰是真的粉絲

追蹤數只告訴你有多少人看過，排行告訴你誰真的在乎。

  1. 1 王小美 2,400

狀態

此檔為空的墓碑檔（tombstone），整份檔案只有一段檔頭註解，宣告自己已被棄用，不含任何實際樣式規則；全站零消費，從未被任何頁面 <link> 真正引入。

2026-07-27：作者原本要做 project-detail.html 檢視／編輯模式的切換樣式，後來才發現 shared.css 早已實作過（見其「檢視模式」段落，約 .pd-tabbar 附近）——兩份檔案管同一件事，正是這個專案一直踩的分岔，所以規則只留在 shared.css。此處刻意不編造 demo markup，因為檔案本身沒有任何選擇器可供展示。

留給未來維護者的提醒（檔頭原話）：作者當時的「是否已連結？」檢查，是用字串比對搜尋 project-detail.html 裡有沒有出現 "ds-components/inline-edit.css" 這段路徑字串——結果命中了自己剛寫的一段中文程式碼註解，比對「通過」，於是真正的 <link> 從未被插入、此檔從未被載入。字串比對抓得到註解；要判斷「這支樣式表是否真的被載入」，得檢查實際存在的 <link ... href="..."> 標籤。

2026-07-31 使用者裁決（版面重整）：
.vault-lens 自成一列橫跨在庫房與內容之上、靠右對齊——它換的是整頁的檢視角度，放側欄會被讀成清單篩選器、放頁首動作列會被讀成一顆按鈕。狀態不另外寫成一句話：側欄逐列標「打不開」＋主欄遮罩＋下拉自己轉橘已經說完了；這一列只是版面，不上底色（內容靠右之後整條上色會變成一大片空色塊）。「回到我的視角」排在下拉左邊，讓下拉守住最右邊界。
頁首不放動作列——建立庫房的入口只留側欄 .vault-rail__new 一顆，且排在 .vault-rail__list 之上，跟按下去長出來的 .vault-rail__draft（清單第一列）連在一起。
空的分區整個不出現（.vault-group--empty／__empty 已退場）：新庫房原本會連續印出四塊「這裡沒有東西」，改成空庫房只給一張 .vault-empty，「三種媒體各自歸位」那句話在那裡講一次。
上傳入口隨狀態換位置——空的時候是 .vault-empty 整塊，有內容之後收進 .vault-gridbar__right 的 ghost 鈕；兩者共用同一個 <input type=file>，拖放綁在 [data-vault-grid] 容器。
.vault-rail__draft 移到清單第一列並拆掉外層卡片（原本橘框卡片＋.input 自己的框＝框中框）。
說明各歸各位：條件細則貼著條件放成 .vault-door__fine，整頁的原型聲明降級為頁尾 .page-note，兩者都不再是壓在媒體清單下面的 .info-banner。

總覽卡片牆 ＋ 單一庫房彈窗（2026-07-31 探索、2026-08-01 退為保存檔 media-vault-popup.html）：使用者試用後裁示正式頁改回清單與詳情並排——可以直接切換庫房、直接編輯 media，不必先開再關一層彈窗。兩種版型共用同一支 js/media-vault.js，靠 <html data-vault-view="popup"> 分流。當初的推導：全站導覽已經是左欄，庫房清單再常駐一欄就變兩條並排；清單天生垂直（縮圖／名稱／內容數／鑰匙數）轉橫排塞不下，所以解法不是轉向，是讓它不要跟主內容同時出現。
頁面只放 .vault-overview 卡片牆（封面放得比 276px 側欄大，「哪座門開得最大」比清單更一眼看得出來）；點一張卡，那座庫房開在 .vault-modal 裡——彈窗內沒有全站導覽，清單因此可以留在左邊，只有一條左欄，換庫房也不必關掉彈窗。外殼沿用 Embed modal，只換尺寸（1320×940）與內部捲動；捲動容器換成 .vault-modal__body，所以側欄與讀數的貼頂高度在彈窗內歸零。庫房名字只寫在彈窗標題列（捲不走），內文不重複。
探索過但沒採用：只留標題旁的切換下拉（看不到全部庫房的概況）、把全站導覽改走頂列（那是全站偏好，為單一頁面改它本末倒置）。

清單靠右（2026-08-01 使用者裁示）：.vault-layout 改成 1fr 276px，用 order 換位置而不動 DOM 順序——清單是在庫房之間導覽的東西，讀屏與 Tab 先碰到它是對的，換的只是它畫在哪一邊；窄版收成單欄時清單回到內容上方（右邊已經不存在，擺下面等於要先捲過整座庫房才選得到下一座）。檢視身分那一列跟著改為靠左、與內容切齊同一條左邊界。

單一內容的設定（2026-08-01 使用者裁示「點進去每個 media 設定裡」）：點格子／音檔列打開右側 Drawer。用抽屜不用第二層彈窗——庫房本身已經是一層彈窗，再疊一層會變成對話框中的對話框，而且會蓋掉剛才點的那一格。內容只放這座原型真的有的欄位（名稱可改；類型／長度／大小／加入日期唯讀，用 <dl> 而非 input，因為它們改不動）與既有的刪除動作。
同一輪：檢視身分搬進彈窗標題列（它問的是「這座庫房從粉絲那一側長怎樣」，是進到庫房才要問的問題；標題列捲不走）；Embed modal 的遮罩底色改黑——原本混的是 --foreground，深色主題下那是接近白的前景色，遮罩因此變成一層白紗，改成與 .payout-modal 同一個配方（--background ＋ --overlay-tint），全站遮罩只剩一種寫法。

區塊標題（2026-07-31 使用者裁示）：.vault-door__label（解鎖條件／誰進得來／已發出的鑰匙／這座庫房裡）原本走「12px 全大寫加字距 muted」的欄位標籤規格——那是標一個輸入框用的。這四個各自帶起下面一整塊內容，是標題，所以改吃 Card 的 .card__title 既有規格（Satoshi 標題體 18px Regular 前景色），與全站區塊標題一致；圖示放大到 16px、維持 muted 色，不跟標題搶字重。

「進得來的方法」（2026-07-31，原型先行、待上游裁決 — ASSUMPTIONS PG-025）：rules 從單層條件陣列改成「方法」清單 [{items:[…]},…]——一個 {} ＝ 一種進得來的方法；任何一種達成就進得來，同一種方法裡的條件要全部達成。例：方法一＝「核心圈 ＋ 買過黑膠」，方法二＝「出席過簽名會」，兩種中一種就開得了門。
方向是外層任一、內層全部——創作者腦中的東西是「我開了幾條路給粉絲走」，每條路各有幾個門檻；反過來同樣算得出結果，但要人自己補括號。
措辭不用邏輯符號：畫面上寫「這些要一起達成」「或是」「多一種進得來的方法」，不寫「且／或／AND／OR」。
漸進顯示：框只在該方法有兩個以上條件時才畫；「或是」在有兩種方法時才出現。空的方法不算達成（否則剛加一種還沒選條件，門就對全站開了），刪到空的自動消失。鑰匙不受影響，永遠疊在條件之上。遮罩上的條件直排、行間寫「或是」——橫排斷行會讓人看不出括號在哪。
這動到的是權限規則，屬產品決策，觸及人數與遮罩文案全部隨之改變；未經上游核准前不得視為正式功能。

寬名稱變體 (.perf-rank--wide，2026-08-09)

  1. 1 《海上霸姬鄭一嫂》為什麼是這五年最好的港產武打片 640 次

長條寬度是資料（--w 由呼叫端算好），色相是分類（--hue 吃 --chart-* token）；.perf-rank--nopct 為無百分比的 4 欄變體。.perf-rank--wide 把名稱欄改吃比例（2fr 對長條的 1fr）、不設固定上限——預設的 148px 是為片名、歌名、平台名這種七八個字的短名訂的，作品全名與貼文標題是一整句，塞進去只看得到前六個字；換成更大的固定值也只是把問題往後推，比例才會把剩下的寬度真的讓給名稱。實際由 js/performance-store.js 與 js/audience-store.js 生成，消費頁：index.html、project-detail.html、audience-report.html、fan-analytics.html。

「畫面乾淨時 Save 按鈕自我停用」——已儲存卻仍亮著的 Save 是在說謊，狀態改由旁邊的時間戳承接安心感；未儲存變更用琥珀色而非紅色，因為此刻還沒有出錯。實際由 js/toast.js（window.ztorToast.show(...)）動態建立於 <body> 下。消費頁：media-vault.html、tier-settings.html、tier-benefits.html。

跨頁佇列 queue() (2026-07-30 新增)

有些確認發生在「按下去就換頁」的動作上（例：建立流程按發布 → 導向項目詳情頁）。show() 只活在當前頁，換頁那一刻就被丟掉；queue() 把訊息先存進 sessionStorage，換頁後由下一個載入 js/toast.js 的頁面在 DOM ready 時「先刪佇列再顯示」——所以中途重整不會把同一則提示再跳一次。任何頁面只要載入 js/toast.js 就自動具備接收能力，不必逐頁接線。

window.ztorToast.queue('項目已發布', {
  key: 'cpp.publish.toast.now',   // i18n key：顯示時機在下一頁，語言可能已切換
  tone: 'success'
});
// → project-detail.html 載入時自動顯示一次，之後從佇列清除

存的是 i18n key 而不是翻好的字串——顯示時機在下一頁，語言可能已被切換過；查不到 key（打錯、字典未補）才退回呼叫時傳入的 message 字串當保底，畫面上不會出現 raw key。首個消費者：create-project.html 的建立流程發布動作，導向 project-detail.html 顯示成功提示。

自製下拉選單，取代瀏覽器原生 <select> 展開後的清單——那部分是作業系統畫的，任何瀏覽器都不開放樣式化。js/zselect.js 在執行期把每個 <select class="select"> 升級成「觸發鈕＋自繪 listbox」，原生 select 留在 DOM 當資料來源。

坐在可切檢視／編輯的面板裡時要標 data-view-safe（2026-08-10）。觸發鈕本體是 <button>，而 shared.css 有一條「[data-mode="view"] 底下藏掉所有按鈕」的規則——那條針對的是動作鈕，不是表單控件；沒標的下拉會在唯讀狀態整顆消失，只剩一個標籤底下空一塊。標了就一起搬到觸發鈕，唯讀時仍看得見選到的值（停用態的淡色）。首個消費者：project-detail.html 公開資訊的年齡分級。

4.111 Finding card

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

One finding that carries its own evidence: the conclusion on the left, the figures that produce it on the right. Written as a paragraph, the numbers get buried in the sentence and the reader has to pull them out to compare — when that comparison is the whole point. Spec 5.1.7.8 F7 requires four parts and refuses fewer: the finding, scannable figures, what it is based on, and a way to drill in.

一則「帶得走證據的結論」：左邊是一句話的發現與依據，右邊是支撐它的數字。寫成一段文字時數字會埋進句子裡，讀的人要自己把兩個數字拉出來比 —— 而那個落差正是整則結論的重點。規格 5.1.7.8 F7 要求四個組成缺一不可：結論句、可獨立掃視的支撐數字、依據與涵蓋範圍、追查入口。

Relationships

元件關係

Built from由哪些元件組成 ↓
atomIcon Button
Sits inside a Card. Distinct from Insight row, which is a single line that says everything it has to say; use Finding card when the conclusion needs figures behind it and somewhere to go next.放在 Card 裡。與 Insight row 的差別：insight-row 一行就講完；結論需要數字支撐、而且要能追查下去時才用本元件。

4.112 Source status

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

A data-coverage indicator that takes no layout of its own. It sits in the page header actions and says two things in one pill — how many sources the figures cover, and whether anything needs attention. The detail opens on click. Coverage is the precondition for reading every number on the page, so it must always be visible; but it is not the task the user came to do, so it must not occupy a block. When something is wrong the whole pill turns destructive and stays that way until it is resolved.

不占版位的資料涵蓋指示。它坐在頁首操作區，用一顆膠囊講兩件事 —— 數字涵蓋幾個來源、有沒有需要處理的異常；明細點開才展開。涵蓋範圍是判讀頁上每個數字的前提，必須隨時看得到；但它不是使用者來這頁要完成的任務，所以不能占掉一個區塊。有異常時整顆轉 destructive 色，且異常排除前不回到低調樣式。

4.113 Auth shell

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

The shell for the pre-login layer — the only surface a visitor sees before the workspace exists. It carries no product navigation: there is no sidebar, no header, no breadcrumb, because none of them can be trusted to mean anything before identity is known. There is no card either — the content sits straight on the page background, matching the ztor consumer login. Every step swaps inside the same column rather than navigating away, so the visitor never loses the sense of being in one place doing one thing.

未登入層的殼，是訪客在工作區存在之前唯一看得到的畫面。它不掛任何產品導航——沒有側欄、沒有頁首、沒有麵包屑，因為身分未知之前這些東西都指不到可信的目的地。也沒有卡片：內容直接坐在頁面底色上，比照 ztor 消費端的登入頁（2026-08-04 使用者裁示）。所有步驟在同一個內容欄裡互切、不換頁，讓訪客始終覺得自己在同一個地方做同一件事。

2026-08-04 使用者裁示再兩件：(1) 內容的垂直起點改成固定——.auth-page 由 align-items:center 換成 flex-start ＋ calc(var(--sp-96) + var(--sp-72)) 上內距（手機 ≤480px 仍是 --sp-96）。置中的問題是四個畫面高度不同，切畫面時標題會上下跳；固定起點之後標題永遠在同一條線上，只有下方在長高。(2) 加上第三方登入——Apple／Google／Facebook／LINE 四個入口。品牌標記是 icons.js 裡唯一非 Tabler 的字符（Simple Icons CC0 官方單色路徑），一律吃 currentColor、不帶品牌彩色值。

2026-08-04 第二輪使用者裁示「將第三方全部都用這種格式」：第三方原本是一列四顆只有品牌標記的方塊（.auth-oauth / .auth-oauth__btn），本輪改成跟電子郵件／手機號碼同一種卡，六張一起住進 F1 那個 .segmented.radio-cards--gate——2 欄 × 3 列，第 1 列是電子郵件／手機號碼、第 2-3 列是四個第三方。用同一個 grid 而不是兩個相鄰區塊，是因為六者是同一個決定的六個答案，切成兩塊會冒出兩種垂直間距在描述同一件事。六張都是「標題＋一行副標」，所以六張等高：副標的職責是回答「怎麼驗證」——前兩張是密碼／簡訊驗證碼，四張第三方的對應事實是「不需另設密碼」，四張共用同一個 i18n key（login.method.oauth.sub）。共用一句是刻意的：它們彼此的差別已經由圖示與名稱說完，副標負責說這一整組跟前兩張差在哪；寫成四句不同的話會變成把 Apple／Google 這些名字再講一次。可讀名稱＝卡面上看得見的標題，login.oauth.* 五個純 aria-label 的 key 一併刪除；.auth-oauth 兩條規則零消費，也一併從 auth.css 移除。

2026-08-04 使用者裁示改成無卡片版：原本的 .auth-card（--card 底＋--shadow-card＋--radius-xl＋--sp-32 內距）改名 .auth-shell 並拿掉全部容器外觀，頁底也由 --surface-shell 換成 --background——--surface-shell 存在的理由是襯托疊在上面的卡，卡沒了就不需要那一層。內層 F1 的兩個登入方式仍是可點方塊（.radio-cards--gate），拿掉的只有最外層那張卡。

步驟切換由 data-auth-step 與 [hidden] 驅動，不換頁也不動 URL——四個畫面（方式選擇／電子郵件／手機號碼／忘記密碼）共用同一個內容欄。.auth-step[hidden]{display:none} 是必要的顯式還原，因為 .auth-step 自己宣告了 display。

ds-components/auth.css。消費頁：login.html（規格 5.1.10 / D170）。這頁不載 js/sidebar.js，骨架照站上唯一的無側欄全畫面先例 scanner.html。全站帳戶選單的「登出」（js/sidebar.js 的 [data-logout]）導回這一頁。

4.114 Ticket tier card

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

A repeatable row for building a list of ticket tiers inside a creation flow. Each card has two faces: collapsed it is a summary — name plus the two facts that decide whether the tier is right (price, quantity); expanded it becomes the edit form and the summary steps aside. Only one card edits at a time, so the list never turns into a wall of open forms.

建立流程裡可重複增列的票種卡。每張卡有兩個面貌：收合時是摘要——名稱加上判斷這個票種對不對所需的兩個事實（價格、數量）；展開時整張變成編輯表單、摘要讓位。一次只有一張卡在編輯，清單才不會變成一整面攤開的表單。

4.116 Ticket preview

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

The ticket a fan ends up holding, shown live while the creator fills the form beside it. Two halves with a tear line between them: the top is identity (when, name or logo, what kind of ticket), the bottom is the QR that gets scanned at the door. The tear is the only metaphor this object needs — it says at a glance which half is for a person and which is for a machine.

粉絲最後拿到的那張票，創作者在旁邊填、這裡即時長出來。一條撕線把票分成兩半：上半是識別（時間、票名或 logo、哪一種票），下半是進場掃的 QR。撕線是這個物件唯一需要的隱喻——一眼就說明哪半張給人看、哪半張給機器掃。

.session-list · __row（--main 為第 1 場）· __no（固定寬序號，讓多列欄位左緣對齊）· __fields（日期｜場地兩欄；--main 改單欄）· __text（--empty 為未填時的降權態）· __end（固定寬尾欄，讓「有移除鈕」與「有徽章」兩種列的右緣也對齊）· __add。2026-08-09 新增：__head[data-multi]（選配欄位標題列，與 __row 同排版、文字改小標色）· .session-list--detailed（多欄修飾類：單場 4 欄「日期｜起｜訖｜入場」，[data-multi="true"] 多插「場次名」成 5 欄，兩種欄寬各自定義；≤640px 時 __head 隱藏、欄位收成 1～2 欄）。

第 1 場為什麼是唯讀鏡像：日期與場地在同一頁上面已經有一組正式欄位，這裡再給一組可編輯的，同一筆資料就有兩個真相來源——使用者改了下面那格，上面那格與 Review 摘要、發布前檢核不知道該聽誰的。改成鏡像後只有「第 2 場起」是這份清單自己的資料。

開關為什麼在「場地與時間」不在確認頁：使用者最初指定放最後的確認頁；確認頁的定位是「檢查每一項沒問題就發布」，在那裡開一個會生出 N 個活動的開關等於在檢查步驟做重大建立動作，而且日期與場地都在前一步填過、要改得跳回去。2026-08-06 與使用者確認後移到「場地與時間」。

清單頁的群組列（住在 product-list.css，不另開元件）：.product-list__row--group[data-group][aria-expanded] ＋ .product-list__group-toggle（展開把手，放在名稱前面——清單頁的 .main 是 overflow-x:hidden，視窗窄一點時右側幾欄會被切掉且捲不到，把手收在最右的操作欄等於沒有入口）＋ .product-list__group-chevron（轉 180°）／.product-list__row--child[data-group-child][hidden]（縮排一階＋左緣 inset 線；用 inset shadow 不用 border-left，border 會參與 grid 欄寬計算讓母子列對不齊）。系列母頁的入口要有名字：母列標題本身是連結（進系列母頁），但母列的整列點擊是「展開」，光靠標題沒人會發現那裡還能點去別的地方，所以操作欄的 ⋮ 另給一個具名項目「管理整個系列」，子場詳情頁的「系列」分頁也放一個。行為約定由消費頁負責：母列整列可點＝展開／收合（明確的展開鈕與 ⋮ 裡那一項一律有效，連結與選單本身放行）；子列不進分頁計數；子列可見＝母列過篩選且展開；搜尋中一律攤開（搜到的字可能長在某一場身上）。

三種活動詳情頁（2026-08-06 使用者裁決）：單場活動（event-detail.html，無系列）／系列母頁（series-detail.html）／系列子場（event-detail.html，有系列）。母頁承載共用設定、改一次同步所有場次；判準是「這個欄位每一場一不一樣」——一樣的（名稱、描述、陣容、圖片、人數、票種與票價）住母頁，不一樣的（日期、場地）住子場。階層要在麵包屑上讀得出來：子場是「活動 / 系列母頁 / 這一場」三層、返回鈕回系列母頁；末層寫「第 N 場 · 場地」不寫活動名稱（同系列各場刻意同名，用名稱三場會一模一樣）。單場活動維持兩層。母頁不是一場活動，所以頁首不掛日期與場地、也沒有報到與名單。入口有兩個：活動清單的母列標題、子場詳情頁「系列」分頁的「管理整個系列 →」。頁面上刻意寫死兩則規則：已開賣的警示用 .alert--row.--warning（沿用編輯活動「改動的後果」同一種說法），以及「取消系列中的一場＝與取消一場獨立活動完全相同的退款規則」。

ds-components/session-list.css ＋ ds-components/product-list.css（群組列）。消費頁：create-event.html（步驟 3 場地與時間 › 系列場次，用 .session-list--detailed ＋ __head）、create-event-legacy.html（基準版）、events.html（系列母列與子列）、series-detail.html（系列母頁，場次表用頁內變體 product-list--series）。產品規格缺口見 ASSUMPTIONS SER-001。

4.118 Entry list

🟡 molecule

Purpose

用途

A field that collects an unknown number of same-kind short entries. One row is one .input plus a trailing remove button; an add button below appends an empty row. Built for the cast and crew step of the work release flow (spec 5.1.2.2.1 §4), where a film may credit one director or three.

用來收「不確定會有幾筆」的同型別短文字。一列是一格 .input 加行尾刪除鈕，下方的新增鈕補一列空的。為作品上架流程的演職人員而建（規格 5.1.2.2.1 §4）——一部片可能掛一位導演，也可能掛三位。

Relationships

元件關係

Built from由哪些元件組成 ↓
atomInput Button Icon
Do not confuse with Spec row: that one holds paired name-and-value data, this one holds a single column where every row answers the same question. Ask whether the row itself needs a field name — if it does, use Spec row.與 Spec row 分工明確：那支收「名稱＋值」的成對資料，這支收單欄清單、每一列都是同一個問題的另一個答案。判斷句是「這一列本身需要欄位名稱嗎」——需要就用 Spec row。

Rendered preview — last row filled, add button offered

Last row still empty — add button withheld

最後一列還空著 — 收起新增鈕

Same markup in both previews — only [data-last-empty] differs. Nine of these sit side by side on the cast-and-crew step, and nine permanent add buttons shouted louder than the names; an add button also buys nothing while the last box is still blank.

兩張示範是同一份 markup，差別只在 [data-last-empty]。演職人員那一步並排九份名單，九顆常駐的新增鈕比名字本身還搶眼；最後一格還空著時按它也不會得到任何東西。

For developers — classes · code給工程師 — class · 程式碼

.entry-list[data-last-empty]（flex column）> .entry-list__row × N（.input 吃滿剩餘寬＋.btn--icon 刪除）＋ .entry-list__add（align-self:flex-start，不跟著拉滿寬）。

只剩一列時不給刪除鈕：清單至少留一格可填，由消費頁的 JS 切 hidden；元件負責的是「藏得掉」——.btn 自帶 display，[hidden] 單靠自己蓋不過去，所以 CSS 有一條 .entry-list__row .btn[hidden] { display:none }。

最後一列還沒填字就不給新增鈕（2026-08-07 使用者反饋）：.entry-list[data-last-empty="true"] .entry-list__add { display:none }。做成元件預設而不是可選變體——目前只有 publish-work.html 一個消費頁，而「上一格填了才問下一格」對任何同質清單都成立；要退回常駐版只要不設這個屬性，沒有 [data-last-empty] 的清單行為完全不變。空／不空由消費頁的 JS 判斷，屬性寫法沿用站上既有的 [data-empty]（Date input、票種卡的清空 ✕），不另立第三種「有值才出現」的機制。

焦點不能跟著按鈕消失：按下新增後那一列是空的、新增鈕當場收起，焦點若留在原地就落在 display:none 的按鈕上，所以消費頁在新增後把焦點交給新那一格的 .input；刪除後同理交給鄰近一列（優先上一列）。兩者都在 publish-work.html 的 bindRole() 內。

surface：內容是 .input 與 .btn--icon，兩者各自對所在層有邊界，容器本身不填色，白底與灰底（--card／--surface-shell／--muted）都成立。

ds-components/entry-list.css。消費頁：publish-work.html（步驟 4 演職人員）。

🟡 molecule

Answers four questions about one submitted item in one block: where it stands, the read-only facts behind that, why it came back if it did, and what can be done next. Built for the platform review of a finished film (spec 5.1.0.4 / 5.1.2.2 §2.2.9) and used on both sides of it — the creator reads the result on the project page, the reviewer reads the same block on the review page.

刻意與項目狀態徽章分開：作品審核狀態講的是「這一件送審作品」，項目狀態講的是「整個項目」，是兩個主體的兩套狀態，規格明令不得互相代用。所以這一塊坐在項目更新區段裡、有自己的徽章，不去改頁首那顆項目狀態徽章。

條件顯示的成員都要能藏：__meta-item、__note、__actions 各自宣告了 display，CSS 逐一補了 [hidden]{display:none}——不補的話 el.hidden = true 藏不掉（審核完成時間在還沒有結果時就會空著一個欄目名）。

surface：--card 底＋1px --border，白底與灰底（--surface-shell／--surface-page）都成立；note 用 --muted 填色，靠比容器深一階被看見。

ds-components/review-status.css。消費頁：project-detail.html（項目更新區段的作品審核狀態）、admin-video-review.html（送審件頁首與審核動作）。產品缺口見 ASSUMPTIONS UIA-109／UIA-111。

4.115 Size chart editor

🟠 organism

Purpose

用途

A data table where the creator controls both axes. Rows are sizes; columns are whatever this garment needs measured — and that genuinely differs per item, so the columns cannot be a fixed set the way every other table on this site has one. Delete affordances stay hidden until you hover the row or column they belong to, because two growable axes means a permanently visible grid of delete icons would outweigh the data itself.

兩個維度都由創作者決定的資料表。列是尺碼、欄是這件衣服需要量的部位——而要量哪幾個部位本來就因商品而異，所以欄沒辦法像站上其他表格那樣是固定集合。刪除鈕平常藏起來、hover 到所屬的那一列或那一欄才浮現：兩軸都會長，一整排常駐的刪除圖示會蓋過資料本身。

Relationships

Built from由哪些元件組成 ↓
atomInput Icon
Visual language is borrowed wholesale from Variant builder's table (frame, muted head, .input cells, row-end delete) so the two read as one family; the dynamic-column mechanism is borrowed from Benefit matrix's --bmx-cols.視覺語彙整套取自 Variant builder 的表格（外框、靜音表頭、.input 格子、列尾刪除），讓兩張表讀起來是同一族；動態欄的機制取自 Benefit matrix 的 --bmx-cols。

欄定義只住在 --sce-cols 這一個變數上（宣告在 .sce__table，__head 與每個 __row 都 var() 取用）。__head 與每一列是各自獨立的 grid container，欄寬要對齊就只能吃同一份 grid-template-columns；JS 增減欄時只改這個變數＋每列補一格 DOM，不動 CSS。

首欄必須固定寬、不能用 max-content：兩個 grid 會各自解析 —— 表頭那格只有文字（72px）、資料列那格是輸入框（152px），兩邊就錯開。已改固定 112px。

表頭的欄名輸入框平常收起邊界：.input 的邊界是 box-shadow 環不是 border，所以要清 box-shadow，改 border-color 沒有作用。

返回鍵對齊標題（2026-08-10 第三輪，使用者反饋「這兩個要對齊」）——__head 原本 align-items: center，返回鍵與「標題＋副標」整個標題群置中對齊；但標題群兩行疊起來共 63px（標題行高 42px＋副標行高 21px），置中只會把返回鍵放到這 63px 的正中央，比標題自己的中心低 10.5px，看起來偏低。改成 align-items: flex-start，再用 margin-top: 3px 把返回鍵的中心精準推到標題那一行的中心：(標題行高 42px − 返回鍵直徑 36px) ÷ 2。

4.121 Field source tag

🟢 atom

Purpose

用途

Marks "where did this field come from" next to a field label (imported from bookyay, can't be edited here), and keeps a locked field readable — it's not broken, it's "managed elsewhere": slightly lower contrast, cursor switches to not-allowed. 欄位標籤旁標記「這一格是從哪裡帶進來的」（bookyay 帶入後不可改），並讓被鎖定的欄位維持可讀——不是「壞掉」而是「別處管的」，只降一點對比、游標改不可編輯。2026-08-09 自 create-event.html 的頁內 .ce-src / .is-locked promote。

Relationships

元件關係

Used by被哪些元件使用 ↑
Consumed inside Source import's post-import form fields; not a standalone control用於 Source import 帶入後的表單欄位內，非獨立控件

Rendered preview

視覺展示

Locked on a Radio card group (.is-source-locked on a .segmented.radio-cards — 2026-08-09: same lock, non-form-control target; see the code tab)

鎖定在 Radio card 群組上 (.is-source-locked 掛在 .segmented.radio-cards 上——2026-08-09：同一套鎖定，作用對象不是表單控件；見下方 code 分頁)

Locked ≠ broken. The locked field drops its fill entirely — it takes whatever surface it sits on, so it never reads as a darker "something went wrong" box inside a card — and its value steps down to --locked-field-ink. Only the 1px border marks where the field is. Compare with the editable field below it: filled surface, full-strength value. Two rounds, both 2026-08-09: first this component defined that transparent look for itself (overriding the then---muted-filled component baseline); then, once the user decided "the whole component library gets exactly one disabled look," that same transparent look was promoted up into input.css's .input:disabled as the sitewide baseline — so this file no longer defines a lock appearance of its own (see the code tab below).

鎖住不等於壞掉。鎖定欄位整個拿掉填底——直接吃它所坐的那個面，所以不會在卡片裡變成一塊更深的「這裡壞了」方塊——值的顏色降到 --locked-field-ink，只留 1px 邊界標示這一格的範圍。跟下面那個可編輯欄位對照：有填底、值是全強度。兩輪修訂，皆 2026-08-09：第一輪本檔自己定義這組透明底樣式（蓋過當時 --muted 填底的元件層基準）；第二輪使用者裁示「整個元件庫只能有一個 disabled 樣子」後，同一組透明底值被上收進 input.css 的 .input:disabled 成為全站基準——本檔因此不再自己定義鎖定外觀（見下方給工程師的 code 分頁）。

.is-source-locked, not .is-locked — that name is already used by Media vault for a completely different meaning (a graded tier locked in viewer mode: dimmed + grayscale + a lock icon). Neither name is namespaced, so if both components ever serve the same page, whichever loads last would silently win. "Source-locked" and "permission-locked" are two different ideas and each needs a name the other can't overwrite.

命名刻意用 .is-source-locked、不用 .is-locked——那個名字已被 Media vault 用在完全不同的語意（檢視器模式下某分級整列打不開：變暗＋灰階＋鎖頭）。兩者都不在自己的命名空間裡，若同頁兩支元件同時服役，載入順序會決定誰的 .is-locked 生效。「來源鎖定」與「權限鎖定」是兩回事，各自要留一個不會被對方覆寫的名字。

.field-source（掛在 .field__label 內、靠右對齊；.field__label:has(.field-source) 才開 flex，避免壓掉一般欄名裡刻意留的空白）· .is-source-locked（掛在欄位容器；本身不再定義表單控件的鎖定樣式，2026-08-09 第二輪——內部的 .input／.textarea／.select 完全吃 Input 的 .input:disabled（透明底＋--locked-field-ink）；.segmented__btn（Radio card 建在它上面）不是表單控件、吃不到 :disabled，鎖定樣式仍由本檔定義——cursor:not-allowed ＋ pointer-events:none）。

權重注意（第一輪的舊寫法，現已不適用）：本檔第一輪曾把鎖定態寫成 .is-source-locked .input:disabled（0-3-0）去蓋過元件層同權重的 .input:disabled（0-2-0）。第二輪把值上收進元件層之後，兩者變成同一份規則，本檔不再需要用權重蓋過誰。

05.1 · Pattern ▸ Cards

How components assemble.元件如何組合

Best-practice assembly recipes — how components combine to meet a creator's goal. Ten cards across four categories (page-level and mid-level); each has trigger / must / should / must-not / edge-cases. Component sections demo the unit only — assembly rules live here.

最佳實務的組合配方 — 元件如何組合起來達成創作者的目標。四個類別共十張卡（頁面級＋中間層），每張都列出 trigger / must / should / must-not / edge-cases。元件段只展示單元本身——組合規則一律寫在這裡（判準見 §4.0）。

LayoutLayoutDetail + persistent railDetail + persistent railAn entity page where editing is split across tabs but a few read-only facts must never leave view (product detail: stock, delivery, linked project) → wrap the page in .page.page--narrow (1056px — the default 1280px plus a 300px rail leaves the main column too wide), then the Detail rail shell: editable Tabs in .detail-main, sticky .detail-rail on the right holding read-only Form section cards built from KV list / Stock bar / KPI. The rail answers "what do I need to know before I change something", so it holds constraints and consequences (stock on hand, delivery method, what this item is attached to), never the fields being edited and never a primary action. Cap it at 3–4 cards — a rail that scrolls has stopped being persistent. Below 1100px it falls in under the main column, so nothing in it may be the only route to a task.編輯分散在多個分頁、但有幾項唯讀事實必須永遠看得到的實體頁（商品細節：庫存、交付、關聯項目）→ 頁面外層用 .page.page--narrow（1056px——預設 1280px 再配 300px 右欄，主欄會太寬），內層用 Detail rail 殼：可編輯的 Tabs 放 .detail-main，右邊 sticky 的 .detail-rail 放唯讀的 Form section 卡，內容由 KV list／Stock bar／KPI 組成。右欄回答的是「改東西前我要先知道什麼」，所以放的是限制與後果（現有庫存、交付方式、這個項目掛在哪），不放正在編輯的欄位、也不放主要動作。卡片控制在 3–4 張——會捲動的右欄就不再是常駐。1100px 以下右欄會掉到主欄下方，所以裡面不能有任何「只有這條路」的任務入口。
05.2 · Pattern ▸ Voice

Task-oriented and finance-honest.以任務為導向,對財務誠實

Talks to an independent creator running their own business: plain about money, royalties, splits, and verification; never hides a fee or a pending state. Sentence case throughout. Imperative for actions, plain present for states.

對象是經營自己事業的獨立創作者:把金錢、權利金、分潤與驗證講清楚;絕不隱藏任何費用或 pending 狀態。全篇用 sentence case。動作用祈使句,狀態用平直的現在式。

Is / Is-not

該有的語氣 / 不該有的語氣

Voice is語氣是Voice is not語氣不是
Plain about money — "You'll receive $842.10 after a 12% fee"把金錢講清楚 — 「You'll receive $842.10 after a 12% fee」Vague — "Earnings will be processed"含糊 — 「Earnings will be processed」
Specific about state — "Pending until 28 Jun"把狀態講具體 — 「Pending until 28 Jun」Falsely settled — "Paid"假裝已結清 — 「Paid」
Action-first — "Request payout"動作優先 — 「Request payout」Feature-first — "Payout management module"功能優先 — 「Payout management module」
Calm, second-person — "You can edit this until the event goes live"冷靜、用第二人稱 — 「You can edit this until the event goes live」Hype / urgency — "Don't miss out!"炒作 / 製造急迫感 — 「Don't miss out!」
Honest about limits — "Bundles aren't available in your region yet"對限制誠實 — 「Bundles aren't available in your region yet」Evasive — "Coming soon" with no reason迴避 — 只說「Coming soon」卻不給原因
Conservative on compliance — "Tax docs are estimates; confirm with your advisor"合規上保守 — 「Tax docs are estimates; confirm with your advisor」Over-promising — "We handle all your taxes"過度承諾 — 「We handle all your taxes」

05.3 · Pattern ▸ States & Interaction

Global interaction defaults.全域互動預設

  • Nav dropdown: hover-open with a 140ms close delay; click toggles; ESC-to-close. Panel bg uses --background.
  • Nav dropdown: hover 開啟,關閉延遲 140ms;點擊切換;按 ESC 關閉。面板背景用 --background。
  • Theme toggle: light / dark / system cycle, persisted; ?theme= one-time override.
  • Theme toggle: light / dark / system 循環,會記住;?theme= 可一次性覆寫。
  • Tabs: single active panel, URL-hash synced. Chips: single-select, result count updates on change. Switch: 150ms knob slide.
  • Tabs: 只有一個作用中面板,與 URL hash 同步。Chips: 單選,變動時更新結果數量。Switch: 150ms 滑鈕動畫。
  • Lifecycle: 404 keeps chrome + link to Dashboard; Empty stub for unbuilt routes; Error = inline Alert --row with retry, never blanks loaded data; never toast-only.
  • Lifecycle: 404 保留外框 + 提供回 Dashboard 的連結;尚未建好的路由用 Empty stub;Error = 行內 Alert --row 附重試,絕不清空已載入的資料;絕不只用 toast。
  • Motion: 150–240ms ease-out; entrance animations gated behind reduced-motion.
  • Motion: 150–240ms ease-out;進場動畫受 reduced-motion 控制。
05.4 · Pattern ▸ Data viz

Chart conventions.圖表慣例

Lives in chart.css (see §4.71). Line chart: default series --primary, comparison --muted-foreground dashed, area fill color-mix(--primary 18%). Source-breakdown palette: --primary → #000 → --status-success → --status-info → #999. Series rely on legend labels, not color alone.

放在 chart.css(見 §4.71)。折線圖:預設序列用 --primary,對照序列用 --muted-foreground 虛線,區域填色用 color-mix(--primary 18%)。來源拆解的配色:--primary → #000 → --status-success → --status-info → #999。序列靠圖例 label 區分,不只靠顏色。

Appendix A

Output formats.輸出格式

DSS v1.4 is output-agnostic. Ztor Creator Studio · R 2.1 ships as CSS Custom Properties (canonical form in ds-components/_tokens.css); below are equivalent representations for other targets.

DSS v1.4 不綁定輸出形式。Ztor Creator Studio · R 2.1 以 CSS Custom Properties 交付(canonical 形式在 ds-components/_tokens.css);以下是給其他目標的等效表示。

Code example — for developers程式碼範例 — 給工程師
:root {
  --background:         #FFFFFF;
  --card:            #FFFFFF;
  --primary:            #ffa33f;
  --primary-foreground: #171717;
  --border:             #EAEAEA;
  --status-success:     #22C55E;
}

Also expressible as Tailwind v4 @theme tokens and W3C DTCG JSON ({ "color": { "primary": { "$value": "#ffa33f", "$type": "color" } } }).

也可表示成 Tailwind v4 @theme tokens 與 W3C DTCG JSON({ "color": { "primary": { "$value": "#ffa33f", "$type": "color" } } })。

DSS v1.4 JSON skeleton.DSS v1.4 JSON 骨架

Code example — for developers程式碼範例 — 給工程師
{
  "record": { "name": "Ztor Creator Studio · R 2.1", "source": "Ztor Creator Studio", "version": "R 2.1" },
  "foundation": { "palette": { "orange": { "500": "#ffa33f" }, "neutral": { "50": "#FFFFFF", "900": "#171717" } } },
  "role": { "color": { "primary": { "bg": "palette.orange.500", "fg": "palette.neutral.900" } } },
  "mode": { "dark": { "color": { "bg": { "canvas": "palette.neutral.900" } } } },
  "component": { "_inventory": "button · badge · … (23 units, each with _layer)" },
  "pattern": { "_cards": { "dashboard-home": {}, "tabbed-section-view": {}, "filter-and-list": {}, "lifecycle-states": {}, "multi-step-wizard": {} } },
  "structure": "(see Pillar 6)"
}

Document graph health.文件關係圖健康度
